etymology.historical_story: Rang illustrates how an older word for a draft or model can remain familiar through a fixed institutional expression. Malaysian readers encounter it especially in rang undang-undang. Kamus Dewan also cross-refers this sense to rangrangan, meaning a draft. Its separate entry for rang meaning rank must not be treated as evidence that the draft sense has the same origin. [DBP: rang](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=246792&keyword=rang)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rang 记成等待讨论的草案：rang undang-undang＝法律还在草案阶段，即法案。

morphology.pattern_note: 后缀 -an 构成表示创作、设想或其成果的名词。词根末尾 a 与后缀 a 分属两个音节；首音节读 é /e/，不是 e pepet /ə/。

senses.zh_definition: 虚构出来的故事、人物或内容；编造之物。
senses.en_definition: An invented story, character, or account; a fabrication.
senses.ms_definition: Cerita, watak atau keterangan yang diwujudkan melalui imaginasi, bukan berdasarkan kejadian sebenar.
senses.nuances: 在文学中可中性地表示虚构；用于指责他人的陈述时，则含编造、不真实之意。cerita rekaan 中的 rekaan 修饰名词，但仍保留名词来源。义项划分依据 [DBP：rekaan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=rekaan)。

senses.zh_definition: 经构思或设计而产生的作品、样式或发明；设计成果。
senses.en_definition: A design, creation, or invention produced through creative thought.
senses.ms_definition: Hasil pemikiran kreatif yang berupa ciptaan, bentuk atau susunan sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 常用于服装、产品、图案和技术创新，通常为中性或褒义；不能因其与“虚构”共用一个词，就理解为假冒产品。

senses.zh_definition: 在头脑中构成的想象、幻想或设想。
senses.en_definition: An imagined conception, fantasy, or mental plan.
senses.ms_definition: Gambaran atau rancangan yang terbentuk dalam fikiran dan belum semestinya menjadi kenyataan.
senses.nuances: 强调头脑中的构想，与义项一、二有交叠。表示正式实施计划时，rancangan 通常更明确；rekaan 可突出想象性。

senses.zh_definition: 推算、估计或计算所得的判断。
senses.en_definition: A reckoning, estimate, or calculation.
senses.ms_definition: Hasil mengagak atau menghitung sesuatu untuk memperoleh perkiraan.
senses.nuances: DBP 收录此义，但现代日常用语中较少见，通常改用 anggaran、perkiraan 或 pengiraan。以下为说明旧有义项的组合示例，不应视为现代高频固定搭配。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 评价作品时，rekaan yang menarik 是自然的赞语；直接说他人的陈述是 rekaan，可能构成对其诚信的指责。

etymology.historical_story: Rekaan is transparently formed from reka and the noun-forming suffix -an. Its dictionary meanings connect storytelling, invention, imagination, and even reckoning: things first take shape in thought. In contemporary usage, context makes the difference between a designer's creation and somebody's fabricated account. This narrative describes its semantic range rather than asserting an uncertain ancient origin.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 按 re-ka-an 三拍读：reka 是“构思”，-an 把构思变成“构思出来的东西”——可以是一件设计，也可以是一段虚构故事。

morphology.pattern_note: 借词整词作为独立词素记忆，不拆成 re- 与 laks。首音节读 é /e/；末尾 ks 同属一个音节。添加 -kan 时保留词根末尾 s。

senses.zh_definition: 不紧张、不受压力催迫的；放松的，轻松自在的。

senses.nuances: 可描述人的状态或活动气氛。口语中的 Relaks! 起劝人放松的作用，不必据此另立为及物动词。标准拼写为 relaks；DBP 也建议按语境使用 santai 或 tenang。参见 [DBP：relaks](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?d=175768&keyword=relaks)。

etymology.historical_story: Relaks is the Malay adaptation of English relax, with the final sound sequence represented by ks. Its established Malay meaning emphasizes a calm state or relaxed atmosphere. DBP explicitly confirms relaks as the correct spelling when answering a question about English relax, showing how a familiar borrowed expression becomes part of standardized Malay vocabulary.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把英语 relax 的结尾 x 换写成 ks，就是 relaks；读 re-laks 时松开肩膀，直接把声音和“放松”连起来。

morphology.pattern_note: rusuk 是不可再作现代词缀分析的词根；meN- 遇 r- 采用 me-，形成 merusuk，r 保留。音节据标准拼写补全；词尾 -k 在常见马来西亚标准语音中实现为喉塞音 [ʔ]。

word_family.gloss: 沿侧面移动；侧卧；从侧面刺

senses.zh_definition: 身体左侧或右侧的胁部、侧腹；也可指其他物体的侧面。
senses.en_definition: The side or flank of the body; the side of an object.
senses.ms_definition: Bahagian sisi tubuh, khususnya kawasan di kiri atau kanan dada.
senses.nuances: 指身体部位时不一定专指骨头，不能机械地一律译为 rib。Rusuk kanan 可以表示右侧胁部。义项参见 [DBP：rusuk](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=rusuk)。

senses.zh_definition: 肋骨；胸廓两侧弯曲的骨条。
senses.en_definition: A rib: one of the curved bones forming the rib cage.
senses.ms_definition: Tulang melengkung pada sisi dada yang membentuk rangka rusuk.
senses.nuances: 常以 tulang rusuk 明确表示骨骼；rusuk 单独出现时也可指肋骨。Sangkar rusuk 指整个胸廓骨架，不是单根肋骨。

senses.zh_definition: 物体的边缘、侧边或外围部分。
senses.en_definition: The edge, margin, or lateral boundary of something.
senses.ms_definition: Bahagian tepi atau pinggir sesuatu benda atau kawasan.
senses.nuances: 这一侧边义在若干固定搭配中保留，日常泛指边缘时 tepi 更常用。Rusuk surat 指信件或纸面的边缘；词典中的 rusuk jalan 指大路旁的小路，而不只是路肩。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: rusuk 是中性的身体部位词，可用于日常交流及正式说明。询问不熟悉的人时，用 bahagian rusuk tuan/puan 比直接使用 kau 更礼貌。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 人体语境中应分清“胁部”与“肋骨”。惯用语 tumbuk rusuk 可指行贿，涉及他人时带有严重指控意味；不能仅按字面理解为击打肋部。

etymology.historical_story: Rusuk belongs to an old Austronesian word family associated with ribs and the rib cage. Comparative records connect Malay with related forms across island Southeast Asia and beyond. Some relatives also name roof rafters or canoe supports, revealing how curved structural pieces can be understood through the shape of a body's ribs. [Austronesian Comparative Dictionary](https://ling.lll.hawaii.edu/dicts/ACD/acd-s_r2.htm).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 双手扶住身体两侧说 ru-suk：扶着的是胁部，里面一根根的是 tulang rusuk。

morphology.pattern_note: ng 表示单一鼻音 /ŋ/，后接 /k/；派生时 meN- 在 /r/ 前表现为 me-，如 merangka，词根的 r 保留。

senses.zh_definition: 骨骼；骨架：构成人或动物身体支撑结构的整套骨头。
senses.en_definition: The skeleton or supporting arrangement of bones in a human or animal body.
senses.ms_definition: Tulang-tulangan tubuh; kerangka.
senses.nuances: 指整体骨骼结构；单根骨头通常称 tulang。tinggal rangka 可夸张形容人瘦得只剩骨头，对人直接使用可能伤人。

senses.zh_definition: 框架；构架：支撑建筑物、车辆或其他物体的基本结构。
senses.en_definition: The supporting frame or structural framework of a building, vehicle, or other object.
senses.ms_definition: Tulang-tulangan rumah atau sesuatu benda; kerangka.
senses.nuances: 侧重承重或支撑的基本构造，例如房屋骨架和自行车车架；不必然包括外壳、墙面或装饰。

senses.zh_definition: 纲要；框架；初步方案：交代整体结构和主要内容、尚未展开细节的计划或草稿。
senses.en_definition: An outline, draft, or general plan setting out the main structure without detailed development.
senses.ms_definition: Buram, bagan atau rancangan yang menyeluruh dan tidak terperinci.
senses.nuances: 常用于作文、项目及政策规划。dalam rangka 可表示“在……框架内”或“作为……工作的一部分”。rangka 不等于 rangkaian“网络；系列”。义项依据 [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=109300&keyword=rangka)。

etymology.historical_story: Dalam bahasa Melayu, rangka menghubungkan tubuh, rumah dan rancangan melalui satu gambaran: struktur yang menyokong keseluruhan. Kamus merekodkan rangka basikal dan rangka rumah bersama makna bagan atau rancangan umum. Hubungan ini boleh difahami sebagai metafora tulang kepada susunan idea. Ia membantu menjelaskan makna, tetapi tidak menetapkan urutan sejarah perubahan makna tersebut. Sumber: [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=109300&keyword=rangka).

etymology.historical_story: Asal sejarah jauh kata rogol tidak dapat dipastikan daripada sumber yang dirujuk. Namun, kamus Melayu memperlihatkan satu keluarga yang jelas: rogol menamakan perbuatan, merogol menamakan tindakan, dan perogol menamakan pelaku. Takrif lama menggunakan bahasa kehormatan perempuan. Ketika mempelajarinya, bezakan ungkapan budaya dalam takrif itu daripada maruah mangsa, yang tidak berkurang akibat keganasan. Sumber: [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=rogol).

etymology.historical_story: Rebecca comes from the Hebrew name Rivqa and is associated with the biblical wife of Isaac and mother of Esau and Jacob. etymology.historical_story: A familiar spelling can conceal a regional word. The supplied Kamus Dewan entry labels rabu as Minangkabau and defines it as lungs. Its food expression dendeng rabu preserves that meaning in the kitchen, while sakit rabu names lung illness. These uses offer a cultural memory route without claiming an unverified ancient origin or connecting this noun to Wednesday.

etymology.historical_story: Malay rasa connects the tongue with inner experience: a person can taste food, feel pain, and experience affection through the same lexical family. Rasakannya combines that base with -kan and the attached pronoun -nya. Its reference therefore comes from the conversation: the thing being experienced may be a flavour, a sensation, or an emotional experience. [DBP: rasa](https://prpmv1.dbp.gov.my/Search.aspx?d=1&k=rasa)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 rasa＝味道／感受，再把 -nya 理解为“它”：rasakannya＝尝尝它／感受它。

morphology.formula: ∅ + rip → rip; rest in peace → RIP
morphology.pattern_note: 必须区分英语整词 rip 与悼念缩写 RIP。前者通常一个音节，后者可逐字母读 R-I-P；输入包没有上下文，不能确定实际指哪一种。两者均不作马来语词缀拆分。

senses.zh_definition: RIP：愿逝者安息，用于悼念死者的缩写表达。
senses.en_definition: RIP, an abbreviation of rest in peace, used as a memorial wish for someone who has died.
senses.ms_definition: Singkatan ungkapan bahasa Inggeris rest in peace yang digunakan untuk menyampaikan harapan agar seseorang yang telah meninggal dunia bersemadi dengan aman.
senses.nuances: 通常写作 RIP 或 R.I.P.；聊天中的小写 rip 可能表达同义。它是完整悼念用语的缩写，并非普通马来语名词；particle 是在指定词性选项中的功能性归类。official 沿用指定数据标签，不表示 DBP 将其认定为标准马来语词。马来文释义为编写说明。[Cambridge Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/dictionary/english/rip)。

senses.zh_definition: 撕裂；撕开；突然用力扯开；也可指物体被扯破。

etymology.historical_story: This spelling brings together distinct English uses. Lowercase rip names tearing and, in computing, extracting recorded media. Uppercase RIP abbreviates rest in peace, a memorial expression. Without capitalization or surrounding text, the packet cannot establish which was intended. Keeping the readings separate prevents a condolence message from being interpreted as an instruction to tear something. [Dictionary reference](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/dictionary/english/rip).

senses.ms_definition: Pasir; negeri ramal bermaksud negeri Arab.
senses.nuances: 现代日常表示“沙”通常使用 pasir。negeri ramal 是传统表达，不宜据此把 ramal 当作任何场景都可替换 pasir 的常用词。依据：[DBP PRPM：ramal I](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=150348&keyword=ramal+I)。

senses.zh_definition: 占卜所用的沙或其他凭据、工具、典籍，用来推断命运或未来之事。
senses.en_definition: Sand or other materials, objects, or texts used to divine fortunes or future events.
senses.ms_definition: Pasir untuk menengok nasib, atau sesuatu yang digunakan untuk melihat nasib atau mengetahui sesuatu yang akan berlaku, seperti kitab nujum.
senses.nuances: 这是输入词典材料中的核心名词义。membaca ramal 通常指占卜，不是阅读现代统计预测。相关表达带有传统占卜语境。依据：[DBP PRPM：ramal](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=ramal)。

senses.zh_definition: 预测、推测或预言未来之事；是 meramal、meramalkan 等形式的动词词根。
senses.en_definition: To predict, forecast, or divine what will happen; the verbal base of meramal and meramalkan.
senses.ms_definition: Bentuk dasar bagi perbuatan menelah atau menjangkakan sesuatu yang akan berlaku.
senses.nuances: 正式主动句通常使用 meramal 或 meramalkan；裸词 ramal 可自然用于 saya ramal 等第一人称被动结构，也常见于省略 meN- 的口语。现代预测是否可靠取决于依据，词本身不保证准确，也不必然涉及占卜。释义概括自 [DBP 的派生词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=150348&keyword=ramal+I)。

etymology.historical_story: DBP identifies ramal I as Arabic-derived and records both sand and materials used in divination. These meanings offer a memorable bridge from sand to fortune-telling, while derivatives such as ramalan also serve modern prediction. etymology.historical_story: Rogers has more than one surname history. The Dictionary of American Family Names links an English form to Roger, while also recording an Irish adoption from Gaelic Mac Ruaidhrí. A familiar spelling therefore need not imply one ancestry. In Malay text, the name is normally retained rather than translated or treated as an ordinary derived word. [Surname reference](https://www.ancestry.com/last-name-meaning/rogers).

etymology.historical_story: Reese belongs to a group of English spellings associated with the Welsh personal name Rhys. As Welsh names circulated in English writing, forms such as Rees and Reece helped represent unfamiliar sounds. These spellings became established names rather than Malay vocabulary. Their appearance in Malay texts usually reflects references to people, not a new Malay lexical root. See [the onomastic study](https://ans-names.pitt.edu/ans/article/download/1187/1186/2376).

etymology.historical_story: Kamus Dewan preserves three homonyms under rak: an imitative sound word, a household storage structure, and a Kelantan term for sparse scrub. The sound entry points readers to derak and records rak-rok for breaking trees. These records capture different strands of Malay vocabulary; they do not establish a common historical origin for the three homonyms. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=241100&keyword=rak)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 读 rak 时在元音后突然收住喉头：[raʔ]。用两个画面分别记忆：书放在架子上；木头突然“咔”地折断。同音不代表同一词源。

etymology.historical_story: The dictionary record presents rapi as a word whose meanings extend from neat appearance to orderly work, secure closure, vigilance, and meticulous attention. These related uses offer a memorable cultural picture of things being properly attended to. Its derivatives include merapikan and kerapian; the supplied segmentation into rap plus i should not be treated as an established origin. See [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=rapi).

senses.en_definition: A propulsion device, vehicle, projectile, or firework driven by an expelled jet.
senses.ms_definition: Kata bahasa Inggeris bagi alat, kenderaan, peluru atau bunga api yang bergerak melalui tujahan bahan yang dipancutkan; padanan bahasa Melayunya ialah roket.
senses.nuances: 未核实 rocket 为规范马来语词头；此处提供英语词义与马来语对应词，不冒称 DBP 官方释义。音标为英式英语读音。rocket → roket 的拼写对应见 [DBP/MABBIM 文献](https://mabbim.dbp.my/wordpress/wp-content/uploads/2015/04/hha97.pdf)；英语义项见 [Cambridge Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/rocket)。以下保留英语搭配。

collocations.zh: 火箭发动机；马来语：enjin roket

senses.zh_definition: 英式英语中的芝麻菜，即常用于沙拉、带辛香味的叶菜；美式英语常称 arugula。
senses.en_definition: A peppery salad plant, also called arugula.
senses.ms_definition: Nama bahasa Inggeris British bagi sayuran berdaun berasa pedas yang digunakan dalam salad, juga dikenali sebagai arugula.
senses.nuances: 菜单中的 rocket 可能是蔬菜，不能机械译为 roket。此植物名称与航天器名称具有不同词源。参见 [Cambridge Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/rocket) 和 [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/rocket)。

senses.zh_definition: 英语动词：急速上升、猛增或飞速移动；也可指用火箭运送或推进。
senses.en_definition: To rise or move very rapidly, or to propel by rocket.
senses.ms_definition: Kata kerja bahasa Inggeris yang bermaksud meningkat atau bergerak dengan sangat cepat, atau menggerakkan sesuatu dengan roket.
senses.nuances: 这是英语动词用法；马来语应按语境使用 melonjak、meluncur 或以 roket 构成的说明性短语。参见 [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/rocket)。

collocations.zh: 迅速成名；马来语：menjadi terkenal dengan cepat

etymology.historical_story: The flying rocket and the salad rocket have different histories. Merriam-Webster traces the flying device's name to Italian rocchetta, meaning a small distaff, while the vegetable name follows a separate route connected with Latin eruca. Malay uses the adapted spelling roket for the flying device. The spelling resemblance therefore hides two distinct origins, making context essential when reading English menus or science texts. [History](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/rocket) [Malay adaptation](https://mabbim.dbp.my/wordpress/wp-content/uploads/2015/04/hha97.pdf)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: rocket 发射到马来语里，拼写变成 roket；但菜单上的 rocket 留在盘子里，是芝麻菜。

senses.ms_definition: Secara kiasan dalam bahasa Inggeris, jalan atau proses yang membawa kepada sesuatu hasil.
senses.nuances: 此义属于英语。以下搭配保留英语形式供辨识，并非马来语固定搭配；翻译时依语境使用 jalan menuju、usaha mencapai 等表达。[DBP：road 的比喻义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=74812&keyword=road)

etymology.historical_story: Here road belongs to the English layer encountered in Malaysian bilingual communication. DBP treats its meanings in the English–Malay dictionary and supplies jalan as the equivalent. Expressions such as road trip also receive Malay translations. The useful cultural story is therefore one of language contact, with English expressions appearing alongside established Malay alternatives. [DBP: road](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=74812&keyword=road)

morphology.pattern_note: root_word 与 root_jawi 按要求保留词包值；实际语言学词根为 rusuh，而 rusuhan 是加 -an 构成的事件名词，因此 is_root 标为 false。词根末尾 h 保留，接元音后缀后音节划分为 ru.su.han。DBP 将 rusuhan 列为 rusuh 的派生词。[DBP 构词资料](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=399076&keyword=rusuhan)

senses.zh_definition: 骚乱；一群人扰乱公共秩序的事件，常伴随暴力、冲突或破坏。
senses.en_definition: A riot or outbreak of collective disorder, often involving violence or damage.
senses.ms_definition: Kejadian merusuh.
senses.nuances: 指扰乱公共秩序的事件，不泛指热闹、吵闹或个别争执。不能把所有 perhimpunan“集会”或 demonstrasi“示威”都称为 rusuhan；本词也不必然包含推翻政权的目的，通常不直接译为“起义”。[DBP 释义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=399076&keyword=rusuhan)

etymology.historical_story: Rusuhan belongs to a Malay word family organized around rusuh, a state of disorder. The suffix -an gives that disorder an event name, while merusuh describes the activity and perusuh identifies a participant. This family is useful when reading public affairs: an account can distinguish what happened, what people did, and who took part. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=399076&keyword=rusuhan)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 读 ru-su-han：先记 rusuh“乱起来”，再加 -an，把“乱”变成一场“骚乱事件”。

morphology.pattern_note: 在现代马来语中作为完整借词词基处理，不能把词尾 -tis 当成能产马来语后缀。按 ro.man.tis 三个音节读；下列词族成员是相关借词，不是由 romantis 加马来语词缀直接生成。

senses.zh_definition: 浪漫的；与爱情、柔情、美感或令人向往的亲密氛围有关的。
senses.en_definition: Romantic; associated with love, affection, beauty, or an atmosphere that evokes these feelings.
senses.ms_definition: Berkaitan dengan percintaan dan keindahan dan lain-lain; romantik.
senses.nuances: 可形容人物、举动、故事、景色或气氛，并不只指恋爱关系，也不必含有性意味。DBP 将其释为 romantik；在文学语境中也可修饰强调情感的诗歌或作家，但不能把所有此类用例都理解为爱情题材。[DBP 释义与双语例证](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=romantis)

etymology.historical_story: Romantis belongs to the international vocabulary of romance and romantic feeling. European forms developed around narratives, imagination, and emotionally charged beauty; their meanings later extended to affectionate relationships and evocative scenery. Malay dictionaries likewise allow romantis to describe both love and beauty. The broader history explains why a landscape can be romantis without depicting a couple. [Historical study](https://www.dbnl.org/tekst/berg018ontw01_01/berg018ontw01_01_0004.php), [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=romantis)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: ro-man-tis 与英语 romantic 音形相近：想象海边、柔光、温柔气氛，一起记住“浪漫”。

morphology.pattern_note: 共两音节，词根不发生音变。常见组合 bulu roma、liang roma 属于合成表达，并非加缀派生。DBP 另收 seroma，意为相同、相似，不能据此把裸词 roma 解释为日常通用的相似。

word_family.gloss: 汗毛；身体上的细毛，属合成表达

senses.zh_definition: 人体皮肤上细软的毛；汗毛，通常说 bulu roma。
senses.en_definition: Fine, soft hair on the human body, usually in the expression bulu roma.
senses.ms_definition: Bulu halus yang tumbuh pada badan manusia, lazimnya disebut bulu roma.
senses.nuances: roma 本身指细毛；毛孔是完整组合 liang roma 或 lubang roma 的意思，不应另立为裸词 roma 的独立义。bulu roma meremang、berdiri bulu roma 可描述受惊、寒冷或强烈感动时汗毛竖起，具体原因由语境确定。依据 [DBP：roma](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=roma)。

etymology.historical_story: Roma belongs to the Sanskrit-derived vocabulary recorded in older studies of Malay. William Edward Maxwell's manual pairs Malay roma, meaning body hair, with Sanskrit roman. Modern Malay commonly uses bulu roma. Its figurative expressions make a small physical detail memorable: fear can be described through the body's fine hairs standing upright. See [Maxwell's A Manual of the Malay Language](https://www.gutenberg.org/cache/epub/25604/pg25604-images.html).

etymology.historical_story: English raven continues Old English hræfn and belongs to a Germanic word family that includes German Rabe. Historical European records also show related bird words used as personal names. This helps explain the connection between the bird and the name Raven, while leaving the meaning of any particular occurrence dependent on capitalization and context. Sources: [Oxford Learner’s Dictionaries](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/raven_1), [Dictionary of Medieval Names from European Sources](https://dmnes.org/2015/3/name/Raven).

etymology.historical_story: Rahsiakan combines the Malay suffix -kan with rahsia, a word associated with Sanskrit rahasya, meaning secret or private. The World Loanword Database documents this Sanskrit source for the related Indonesian form rahasia. In Malaysian Malay, the shorter root rahsia takes ordinary Malay morphology, producing a direct instruction to keep something undisclosed. The borrowed root is remembered as a whole. [Loanword evidence](https://wold.clld.org/word/71261839445244510)

etymology.historical_story: Rahsia is traced to Sanskrit rahasya, associated with secrecy and private knowledge; rahsianya combines that borrowed base with Malay -nya. The complete form therefore joins an older lexical inheritance to living Malay grammar. Today it can introduce either someone's concealed information or, more warmly, the practical secret behind an excellent dish or a successful undertaking. [Etymological reference](https://www.wisdomlib.org/history/book/sanskrit-words-in-southeast-asian-languages/ocr/1595120/610)

senses.zh_definition: 双方或多方为解决分歧、处理问题或达成协议而进行的商谈；协商；谈判。

senses.ms_definition: Perbincangan antara dua pihak atau lebih untuk menyelesaikan masalah atau mencapai persetujuan.
senses.nuances: 强调通过商谈寻找共识，可以涉及价格、劳资关系或和平安排，不必存在激烈冲突。rundingan 是名词，表示“进行商议”时用 berunding。马来语释义据 DBP 释义展开改写。参见 [DBP：runding 及派生词](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=runding)。

senses.nuances: DBP 收录的内容义，现代日常使用中不如“谈判、协商”义常见。表示某人的意见或劝告时，pendapat 或 nasihat 通常更直接。以下搭配用于明确指向商谈内容，并非独立固定成语。参见 [DBP：rundingan 的第二义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=runding)。

etymology.historical_story: Rundingan is formed from runding with the noun-forming suffix -an. DBP records older meanings of runding involving reckoning and consideration, alongside serious discussion. This semantic range connects weighing a matter with talking it through. In contemporary use, rundingan commonly names the discussions through which parties seek agreement or settle differences. [Source: DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=runding).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: runding 是“认真商量”，加 -an 把动作变成一场“商谈”：berunding 做动作，rundingan 指谈判。

etymology.historical_story: Ramuan belongs to the Malay family built around ramu, gathering materials for use. Dictionary examples connect this activity with roots and leaves for medicine, and timber for houses. The noun therefore reaches beyond the kitchen. Its figurative use invites another image: success, like a carefully prepared dish, depends on bringing suitable elements together.

etymology.historical_story: Rishabh is a modern personal-name form associated with Sanskrit ṛṣabha. Sanskrit dictionaries record meanings including 'bull' and, especially in compounds, 'the best' or 'chief'. The historical word also occurs as a personal name. These associations explain the name's linguistic background; they do not make Rishabh a Malay word for an animal or a description of every person bearing the name. [Sanskrit dictionary evidence](https://www.wisdomlib.org/definition/rishabha).

etymology.historical_story: Rhodes enters this entry as an unresolved proper name rather than a verified Malay common word. One established reference is the Greek island; another is the surname commemorated by the Rhodes Scholarship, established through Cecil Rhodes's will in 1902. These references must remain distinct until the original context identifies the intended one. [希腊国家旅游机构](https://www.visitgreece.gr/en/mainland/islands/rhodes)；[牛津大学](https://www.campaign.ox.ac.uk/rhodes)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先看前面的词：Pulau Rhodes 是岛；Biasiswa Rhodes 是奖学金。靠语境认专名，不靠字母硬拆词根。

senses.ms_definition: Tumbuhan renek daripada genus Rosa serta bunganya, yang juga disebut mawar.
senses.nuances: ros 与 mawar 在一般用语中同指玫瑰，bunga ros 强调花，pokok ros 强调植株。中文日常可译“玫瑰”，但植物学范围是 Rosa 属，不限于单一物种。释义依据输入包所引《Kamus Dewan》第四版。大写人名 Ros 须按人名处理。

etymology.historical_story: Malay has two familiar names for the rose: ros and mawar. Their coexistence lets speakers identify the same flower through different lexical forms. Ros resembles European flower names such as English rose and Dutch roos, but resemblance alone cannot establish a precise borrowing route. The supplied dictionary evidence establishes its botanical meaning, rather than a dated history of transmission.

morphology.formula: ∅ + rileks → rileks（非规范口语拼写；规范形式为 relaks）
morphology.pattern_note: 作为整词记忆，不拆分 ri- 或 -leks。rileks 与规范拼写 relaks 的对应属于拼写和语音变体，不是加词缀过程。所列 IPA 是按该口语拼写推定的读音，不是 DBP 核定音标。

使放松；使松弛，派生自 relaks

senses.zh_definition: 非规范口语形式：放松的、轻松的或不紧张的；规范马来语拼写为 relaks。
senses.en_definition: An informal, nonstandard spelling of relaks: relaxed, calm, or free from pressure.
senses.ms_definition: Ejaan tidak baku bagi relaks, iaitu tenang, santai atau bebas daripada tekanan.
senses.nuances: Rilekslah! 在口语中可用于劝人放松或别紧张。语气过于随便时也可能让对方觉得其忧虑被轻视。以下搭配用于展示口语形式；正式文字应采用 relaks。

etymology.historical_story: Rileks is associated with English relax and corresponds to the standard Malay spelling relaks. DBP explicitly recommends relaks rather than rileks or releks. The contrast offers a practical lesson in borrowing: a familiar conversational spelling can circulate alongside a codified form, while formal Malay writing follows the established spelling.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 听见 ri-leks 就想到 relax、放轻松；正式写作再记一步：马来语规范写 relaks。

senses.zh_definition: 阻碍行动、进展或目标实现的障碍、阻力或干扰。
senses.en_definition: An obstacle, hindrance, or interference that impedes movement or progress.
senses.ms_definition: Sesuatu yang merintangi; halangan atau gangguan.
senses.nuances: 既可指实际障碍物，也可指资金、制度或个人处境造成的困难。比 masalah 更突出“挡住前进”的作用，不必然含有人为敌意。释义及构词依据：[DBP：rintang](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274404&keyword=rintang)。

senses.zh_definition: 电阻；电路元件对电流的阻碍程度，以其两端电压与流经电流的比值表示，单位为欧姆。
senses.en_definition: Electrical resistance: the ratio of the potential difference across a component to the current through it, measured in ohms.
senses.ms_definition: Nisbah beza keupayaan merentasi sesuatu komponen elektrik kepada arus yang mengalir melaluinya.
senses.nuances: 物理与电学术语。rintangan 指电阻这一物理量，perintang 指电阻器；kerintangan 指电阻率。定义依据：[DBP：学校科学术语](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=206468&keyword=rintangan+elektrik)。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 讨论工作困难时，以具体情况作主语较为得体，如 kekurangan dana menjadi rintangan；直接说某人是 rintangan 容易显得指责。

etymology.historical_story: Rintangan is formed from rintang with the noun-forming suffix -an. The related vocabulary includes things lying across a route and actions that obstruct progress. This provides a useful bridge between physical barriers and difficulties in life. Scientific Malay also uses rintangan for electrical resistance, giving obstruction a precise measurable application.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: rintang 是“挡住”，加 -an 变成“挡路的障碍”；生活有阻碍，电流有电阻。

senses.zh_definition: 英语：实际存在或发生的；真实的，而非虚构或想象的。
senses.en_definition: Actually existing or occurring, rather than imagined or invented.
senses.ms_definition: Benar-benar wujud atau berlaku; bukan khayalan atau rekaan.
senses.nuances: DBP 的相关检索结果将 real 列在《Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan》的英语词条下，不能据此认定它是正式马来语词。马来语可按语境用 sebenar、nyata 或 benar。以下搭配采用规范马来语对译。见 [DBP：real](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=real)。

collocations.en: a real story; a true story

senses.zh_definition: 英语：真正的、货真价实的；非仿制或伪造的。
senses.en_definition: Genuine or authentic, rather than artificial or counterfeit.
senses.ms_definition: Asli atau tulen; bukan tiruan atau palsu.
senses.nuances: 强调真伪或材质，与上一义的“是否实际存在”有所区别。马来语中的 asli、tulen、sebenar 不能在所有搭配中互换；应根据对象选择。释义为编写的马来语对译。见 [Merriam-Webster：real](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/real)。

senses.zh_definition: 英语专业用法：数学中指实数的；经济学中指扣除价格变动影响后的实际值。
senses.en_definition: In mathematics, relating to real numbers; in economics, adjusted for changes in prices.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam matematik, berkaitan dengan nombor nyata; dalam ekonomi, diselaraskan untuk mengambil kira perubahan harga.
senses.nuances: 两个领域的马来语对应词不同：数学通常用 nyata，经济学通常用 benar 或 sebenar，须遵循具体术语。它们不是把英语 real 原样当作马来语形容词使用。见 [DBP：real](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=real)。

senses.zh_definition: 英语非正式用法，尤见于美式英语：很；非常。
senses.en_definition: Very; used informally, especially in American English.
senses.ms_definition: Sangat atau betul-betul, dalam penggunaan bahasa Inggeris tidak formal.
senses.nuances: 这是英语副词用法，不是已核实的马来语程度副词。例如 real good 的马来语对应表达是 sangat bagus。以下列的是对应表达。见 [DBP：real](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=real)。

etymology.historical_story: The English adjective real came through French from Latin forms associated with res, meaning a thing or fact. Its history connects reality with things that exist. Currency names spelled real have a different route through words meaning royal, so identical spelling does not guarantee a shared origin. See [Merriam-Webster: real](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/real).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: real＝真的：问存在，用 nyata；问事情真假，用 sebenar；问材质或真品，用 asli 或 tulen，搭配决定选词。

etymology.historical_story: Rakesh belongs to an Indian naming tradition rooted in Sanskrit. Its historical components are rākā, referring to the full moon, and īśa, meaning lord or ruler, yielding the conventional interpretation “lord of the full moon.” In Malay usage it functions as a person's name; that historical interpretation is not an everyday Malay noun meaning. [Name etymology](https://www.behindthename.com/name/rakesh).

etymology.historical_story: Rapunzel's name comes from the plant coveted by her mother in the German tale. Her father takes it from a sorceress's garden and promises the unborn child in return. The sorceress later names the girl Rapunzel. The German plant name has several botanical interpretations, so the narrative connection is firmer than identifying one universally agreed species. [Grimm text and scholarly notes](https://sites.pitt.edu/~dash/grimm012.html)

etymology.historical_story: Republik belongs to an international political vocabulary ultimately associated with Latin res publica, meaning public affairs or the commonwealth. The expression directs attention to the community's affairs rather than a ruler's private possession. This explains a useful conceptual association, but the exact language through which the Malay form was borrowed is not established here. [Australian Parliament discussion](https://www.aph.gov.au/binaries/senate/pubs/pops/pop24/c01.pdf).

etymology.historical_story: English rabbit continues Middle English rabet. Merriam-Webster traces it probably through a Walloon French form to Dutch forms, while retaining uncertainty about that route. Its recorded English history begins in the fourteenth century. This is an English etymology: the Malay translation arnab is a separate word, not a morphological development of rabbit. [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/rabbit)

etymology.historical_story: One established origin of Russell is the Norman French russel, a diminutive related to rous, meaning red. It could identify someone associated with red hair before becoming a hereditary surname. This explains a historical naming tradition, not the appearance, ancestry, or identity of every modern person called Russell. Source: [Patrick Woulfe, Irish Names and Surnames](https://libraryireland.booksulster.com/names/r/ruiseil.php).

etymology.historical_story: Remeh is treated here as an established Malay base rather than assigned an unverified ancient origin. Its word family shows how judgments of importance become actions: remeh describes something insignificant, while meremehkan means treating something as insignificant. The rhyming form remeh-temeh groups small, supposedly unimportant matters together, making it especially useful when discussing everyday disagreements and priorities.

etymology.historical_story: English raccoon comes from a Powhatan word recorded in several spellings around 1600. Its source is commonly interpreted as referring to scratching with the hands, an image that suits the animal’s dexterous forepaws. Malay uses the adapted spelling rakun. The animal’s name therefore connects an Indigenous American language, English borrowing, and Malay spelling adaptation. [Etymonline: raccoon](https://www.etymonline.com/word/raccoon).

etymology.historical_story: Malay dictionaries connect the physical and figurative meanings of rapuh: wood can break, while relationships and resolve can fail under pressure. This offers a useful cultural image of strength as something that must hold together. The consulted dictionary documents these meanings but does not establish the word's deeper historical origin.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ra-puh 联想成木板受压后“啪”地断开：物体易断，关系也可能经不起压力。此为记忆联想，并非词源解释。

morphology.pattern_note: 阿拉伯语来源的整词，在马来语中作为独立词素记忆；不是 ra- 加 -di。/ra.di/ 为马来语适应读法。不据此生造派生词。

senses.en_definition: Willing or wholehearted, used in the expression sudi dan radi.
senses.ms_definition: Sudi dan rela hati, seperti dalam ungkapan sudi dan radi.

etymology.historical_story: The supplied Dewan entry identifies radi as Arabic in origin and preserves it through sudi dan radi, meaning willing and wholehearted. Its Jawi spelling retains the Arabic letter ض. This offers a small glimpse of Arabic contact in Malay vocabulary: a source-language spelling can remain visible even when everyday speakers prefer another expression.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 radi 连进完整短语 sudi dan radi：两个词一起记成“愿意又甘心”。这是短语记忆法，不是构词拆解。

morphology.pattern_note: 词根 rai 的 a、i 分属两个音节，接 -kan 后为 ra.i.kan，不发生辅音替换。Raikan 常用于祈使句，也用于 saya raikan 等第一人称被动结构；一般主动陈述句通常使用 meraikan。输入未提供音节及 Jawi，相关字段保留 null。

etymology.historical_story: Raikan is formed from rai and the suffix -kan. Its dictionary meanings connect honouring people with celebrating occasions: a reception may welcome guests while also marking a wedding or achievement. That connection offers a useful cultural picture of celebration as hospitality. The supplied evidence does not establish the root’s deeper historical origin.

etymology.historical_story: Latin rex means ‘king’. In 1905, Henry Fairfield Osborn named Tyrannosaurus rex, combining a genus name meaning ‘tyrant lizard’ with this royal epithet. The resulting ‘tyrant lizard king’ became a memorable scientific name. This history explains the dinosaur usage, but does not establish what the isolated token in the supplied packet denotes. [Sources: Smithsonian](https://www.si.edu/es/newsdesk/factsheets/tyrannosaurus-rex), [AMNH](https://www.amnh.org/dinosaurs/tyrannosaurus-rex).

etymology.historical_story: Rasai illustrates how Malay connects tasting with lived experience. The rasa family covers food, emotion, pleasure, and suffering. Kamus Dewan also records a separate Minangkabau-labelled rasai entry centred on hardship. Keeping these records distinct prevents a regional suffering sense from overshadowing the ordinary invitation to taste or experience something. [DBP word-family record](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=merasai).

morphology.pattern_note: -nya 直接连写，词根不变，ny 表示单一鼻音 /ɲ/。此处 -nya 通常回指前述的人或事项，形成“其风险／该风险”。suffix 为本模式的归类，语法上须区分代词附着成分与一般派生后缀。headword.jawi 按输入保留，但该串仅对应 risiko；完整 risikonya 应写 ريسيکوڽ。

senses.zh_definition: 其风险；该风险；与前述的人、行动或情况有关的受损、遇险或遭受损失的可能性。
senses.en_definition: The risk associated with a previously mentioned person, action or situation; the possibility of harm or loss.
senses.ms_definition: Kemungkinan berlakunya bahaya atau kerugian yang berkaitan dengan orang, tindakan atau keadaan yang telah disebut.
senses.nuances: -nya 的所指依上下文确定，不固定表示“他的”，也不是复数标记。risikonya tinggi 表示风险较高，不表示损害已经发生。释义根据 DBP 对词根 risiko 的解释编写，不是该连写形式的独立词典引文。[DBP：risiko](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=risiko)

senses.zh_definition: 其不利后果；某种行动可能带来或已经造成的损失、麻烦或其他不良结果。
senses.en_definition: The adverse consequences or unwelcome outcome of an action, identified by context.
senses.ms_definition: Kesan buruk atau hasil yang tidak diingini daripada sesuatu tindakan yang dirujuk dalam konteks.
senses.nuances: 对应 risiko 的“不利结果、后果”义，与 padah 接近。是否已经发生须看上下文；不要在所有句子中都把 risikonya 理解为已经造成的损害。[DBP：risiko 的第二义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=risiko)

etymology.historical_story: DBP's thesaurus labels risiko as originating from English, placing it within the international vocabulary of risk. Malay combines this established noun with its own attached element -nya. The result illustrates how borrowed vocabulary enters local grammar: a word for danger or loss becomes a reference to the particular risk already under discussion. [DBP entry](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=risiko).

senses.zh_definition: 正式地；以获得有关机构或有权者确认、宣布或认可的方式。

senses.ms_definition: Yang rasmi bagi orang, institusi atau perkara yang dirujuk oleh -nya, seperti dalam frasa nama rasminya.
senses.nuances: 这是 rasmi 与领属附着语 -nya 的组合，不是另一个独立词义。nama rasminya 意为“其正式名称”，不能把这里的 rasminya 译为“正式地”。

etymology.historical_story: Rasmi belongs to Malay's Arabic-derived vocabulary and corresponds to Arabic rasmī, meaning official or formal. Malay combines this established adjective with its own -nya. The resulting form illustrates how borrowed vocabulary participates in local grammar: secara rasminya describes official status, while nama rasminya identifies the official name of something already mentioned.

morphology.pattern_note: rawat 是无词缀词根。加 meN- 时，在词首 r 前使用 me-，形成 merawat，保留 r；加 peN- 时相应形成 perawat。

senses.zh_definition: 通过给予药物、医疗处置或适当照护，治疗、护理病人或处理伤病。
senses.en_definition: To treat an illness or injury, or nurse a sick person, by providing medical attention or appropriate care.
senses.ms_definition: Memelihara, menyelenggarakan, membela, menjaga (orang sakit dan lain-lain) dengan memberi ubat dan sebagainya.
senses.nuances: 强调治疗或护理的行为，并不保证病人已经痊愈。标准陈述句中的主动及物形式通常是 merawat，被动形式是 dirawat；rawat 常见于祈使句，口语中也可省去主动前缀。此义依据 [DBP《Kamus Dewan》第四版](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=merawat)。

collocations.en: to treat or nurse a patient

senses.zh_definition: 通过适当的照料、养护或处理，维持或改善植物等对象的状况。
senses.en_definition: To tend, maintain, or treat something in order to preserve or improve its condition.
senses.ms_definition: Memelihara dan menyelenggarakan sesuatu, termasuk tumbuh-tumbuhan, supaya keadaannya baik.
senses.nuances: 这是照料义的非医疗用法；具体措施取决于对象。照料植物时可包括处理病害、修护等，不宜把 rawat 当成所有清洁、维修或管理行为的通用替代词。此处按 [DBP 所列的养护义及果树例句](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=merawat)细分，马来语释义为释义性改写。

etymology.historical_story: The modern Malay family of rawat connects everyday care with institutional medicine: merawat names the action, rawatan the treatment, and jururawat the nursing profession. DBP also illustrates merawat with fruit trees, showing that its recorded meaning extends beyond patients to tending living things. This is a documented lexical connection, not a proven origin story; the supplied evidence does not establish an earlier source language. See [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=merawat).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ra.wat 想成护理的两拍：ra——认真照料，wat——完成处理。再串联 rawat → merawat（治疗、照料）→ rawatan（治疗、护理）。这是记忆联想，并非词源解释。

etymology.historical_story: A Sanskrit connection is proposed through siddhir astu, a wish that success may follow; a scholarly study lists this expression alongside restu. This offers a historical link between wishing someone well and granting a blessing. Modern Malay also applies the word to approval from parents and other authorities. The precise transmission into Malay remains less certain. [NUSA linguistic study](https://sealang.net/archives/nusa/pdf/nusa-v41.pdf).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 restu 想成出发前父母点头送上的祝福：得到 restu，既获认可，也带着好意前行。

senses.nuances: 评价色彩依语境而定；不必然指暴力。依据：[PRPM：radikal](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=radikal)。

senses.zh_definition: 【化学】自由基；具有未成对电子的原子或原子团。
senses.en_definition: An atom or group of atoms with an unpaired electron.
senses.ms_definition: Atom atau kumpulan atom yang mempunyai elektron tidak berpasangan, lazimnya sangat reaktif.
senses.nuances: 常写作 radikal bebas。旧教材也用 radikal 指作为整体反应的原子团，须依上下文区分。依据：[PRPM：radikal](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=radikal)。

senses.ms_definition: Tanda √ yang menunjukkan bahawa punca sesuatu kuantiti perlu ditentukan.
senses.nuances: 主要作为 tanda radikal 中的术语成分使用；无指数时表示平方根。依据：[PRPM：punca](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=punca+kuasa)。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 评价方案为 radikal 可以表示大胆或彻底；直接称某人为 radikal 则容易带出政治指责，宜说明所指观点或行动。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 政治讨论中区分根本改革、极端立场与暴力行为。化学和数学语境采用各自技术义，不附加对人的价值判断。

etymology.historical_story: DBP identifies radikal as an English borrowing. English radical ultimately comes from Latin radicalis, related to radix, meaning root. That image links fundamental change with going to the roots of a problem. Political usage developed around far-reaching reform, while scientific terminology acquired specialized meanings. Malay retains these distinct everyday and technical uses. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=radikal), [Oxford English Dictionary](https://doi.org/10.1093/OED/8608495395)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 radikal 连到英文 radical，再想“动到根”：改革动根本，政治求根本改变；科学义另外记。

morphology.pattern_note: 后缀 -an 构成表示行为内容或结果的名词；词根保持不变。资料包音节标记为 ra.yuan，清晰读音可分为 ra.yu.an。

word_family.gloss: 恳求；请求复议；以甜言软语劝说

senses.zh_definition: 为打动、安慰或说服对方而说的温柔话语、甜言蜜语或劝诱之辞。
senses.en_definition: Coaxing or flattering words intended to soothe, charm, or persuade someone.
senses.ms_definition: Kata-kata manis atau pujukan untuk menyenangkan hati, memikat atau memujuk seseorang.
senses.nuances: 常见于感情、文学或劝说语境；可表示真诚的软语，也可暗指不可信的甜言蜜语。英语 appeal 表示一般吸引力时，通常应译为 daya tarikan，不能一概译为 rayuan。释义依据 [DBP PRPM：rayuan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=113780&keyword=rayuan) 改写。

senses.zh_definition: 向某人或机构提出的恳求、请求或申诉，通常希望获得帮助、宽待或重新考虑。
senses.en_definition: An earnest request or appeal for help, consideration, or a favourable decision.
senses.ms_definition: Permintaan yang dikemukakan kepada seseorang atau sesuatu pihak untuk mendapatkan bantuan atau pertimbangan.
senses.nuances: 可用于入学、奖学金、援助或行政决定等语境；不一定涉及法院。surat rayuan 是申诉或恳求信，具体中文译法取决于所请求的事项。

collocations.zh: 申诉信；请求重新考虑的信

senses.zh_definition: 向较高一级法院或主管机关提出的上诉或复核申请，要求重新审查较低一级机构的决定。
senses.en_definition: An application to a higher court or authority to review a decision of a lower court or authority.
senses.ms_definition: Permohonan kepada mahkamah atau pihak berkuasa yang lebih tinggi untuk menyemak keputusan pihak yang lebih rendah.
senses.nuances: 这是法律及正式程序中的专门义项。上诉不等同于普通投诉 aduan；此处说明词义，不涉及具体程序或期限。

etymology.historical_story: Rayuan belongs to the Malay family built around rayu, associated with persuasion and pleading. The suffix -an turns that activity into a noun naming the words or request produced. Its dictionary meanings span intimate coaxing, public requests, and formal appeals, showing how persuasion can operate both between individuals and within institutions.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rayu 想成开口软语恳求；加上名词后缀 -an，rayuan 就是说出口或写下来的那份恳求。

etymology.historical_story: The supplied lowercase form has no verified Malay etymology in the evidence reviewed. A documented cultural connection is the personal name Ramon in the Ramon Magsaysay Award. Malaysian journalist Abdul Samad Ismail received this award in 1994 for his contribution to journalism and nation-building. This establishes a proper-name context, rather than a history for an ordinary Malay word. [Source: Ramon Magsaysay Award Foundation](https://rmaward.asia/rmawardees/samad-ismail-abdul/)

etymology.historical_story: Rusak and Malaysian Malay rosak illustrate variation across closely related regional language standards. Indonesian retains rusak as its dictionary headword, while DBP prescribes rosak for Malaysian spelling. Related forms also appear in regional Malay materials. The useful historical lesson is that shared vocabulary can develop different accepted written forms; this evidence alone does not establish a borrowing direction.

etymology.historical_story: Malay dictionaries distinguish the familiar bodily word riba, meaning lap, from a separate Arabic loan concerning interest. Their identical Roman spelling can hide that distinction. The domestic word forms derivatives such as meriba, while the financial word belongs to religious and commercial discussion. A shared spelling does not establish a shared origin. [DBP dictionary](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=54140&keyword=riba)

etymology.historical_story: Raghav is commonly associated with Sanskrit Rāghava, meaning a descendant of Raghu, especially Rama in Sanskrit literature. Its historical background concerns a personal name rather than Malay affixation. This association does not establish a Malay dictionary sense, a particular bearer's religion, or one universal pronunciation. See the [Monier-Williams Sanskrit dictionary](https://www.sanskrit-lexicon.uni-koeln.de/scans/MWScan/MWScanpdf/mw0872-rAkSoghna.pdf).

etymology.historical_story: Two unrelated dictionary entries share the spelling rum. Kamus Dewan marks the dairy word as Dutch in origin and separately records the alcoholic drink. English rum is documented from the seventeenth century, possibly as a shortening of rumbullion, though that explanation remains uncertain. The shared spelling therefore conceals different histories and sharply different ingredients. [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=250808&keyword=rum); [Oxford](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/rum_1)

etymology.historical_story: Robinson developed as an English patronymic: a name identifying someone through a parent. Its historical meaning is “son of Robin,” with Robin itself a familiar form of Robert. The name therefore preserves an older naming practice in which a personal relationship became a hereditary family label. This historical structure is not Malay morphology. [Source: Behind the Name](https://surnames.behindthename.com/name/robinson).

etymology.historical_story: One documented explanation connects Ranjit with Sanskrit rañjita, meaning coloured, pleased or delighted. Treat this as a documented name origin, not a Malay dictionary sense. [Source: Behind the Name](https://www.behindthename.com/name/ranjit).

senses.nuances: 例如 Jangan rosakkannya 意为“别把它弄坏”。正式主动陈述通常用 merosakkannya，如 Dia merosakkannya；口语 Dia rosakkannya 省略了 meN-。这里 -nya 承接前文宾语，不能理解为“他的损坏”。基本使动意义参见 [DBP PRPM：merosakkan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=206468&keyword=merosakkan)。本条马来语释义为据词根与结构编写的释义，并非独立 DBP 词条原文。

etymology.historical_story: This form illustrates productive Malay word building. Rosak describes a damaged condition; -kan supplies the causative action, and attached -nya refers back to an object already mentioned. The result can occur in a warning about borrowed equipment or something less tangible, such as trust. No unsupported ancient borrowing history is needed. See [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=82736&keyword=rosak).

etymology.historical_story: Runcit brings together variety and small quantities: the assorted everyday goods of a grocery shop and the retail practice of selling directly to consumers. Modern expressions such as harga runcit extend this familiar shop vocabulary into commercial reporting. DBP documents these meanings but does not establish a specific ancient origin or donor language. [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=runcit)

etymology.historical_story: Robby belongs to an English naming tradition in which familiar forms accompany longer personal names. It is recorded as a diminutive of Robert, alongside related forms such as Rob and Robbie. When used in Malay conversation, it remains a person's name; its English nickname ending does not become a productive Malay suffix. [Source](https://www.behindthename.com/name/robby)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: Robby 对应“罗比”，联想到 Robert 的亲昵称呼；把它作为姓名整体记住，不把结尾 y 当作马来语词缀。

etymology.historical_story: Ronald is the Scottish form of the Old Norse name Ragnvaldr, introduced to Britain through Scandinavian settlement. Its historical elements connect counsel with rulership. The name later spread beyond Scotland, becoming widely used elsewhere during the twentieth century. Those ancient elements explain its ancestry; they are not productive Malay morphemes or descriptions of a modern bearer. See [Ronald name history](https://www.behindthename.com/name/ronald).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Ronald 作为一个完整名牌来记；Ron、Ronnie 是可能的昵称，只有本人这样自称时再使用。

word_family.gloss: 提交有关方面处理或研究；转交

senses.zh_definition: 供查阅、核实或进一步了解某事的资料、来源或参考依据。
senses.en_definition: A source consulted for information, clarification, or verification.
senses.ms_definition: Bahan atau sumber yang boleh dirujuk untuk memperoleh maklumat lanjut tentang sesuatu perkara.
senses.nuances: 这是输入词典释义的核心义，可指书籍、文件、数据库或其他资料。untuk rujukan 表示供日后查阅，不一定表示必须照办。[DBP：rujuk 与 rujukan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=115704&keyword=Rujuk)

senses.zh_definition: 文中标示资料出处的引注，或列出所引用来源的书目记录。
senses.en_definition: A citation or bibliographic reference identifying a source used in a text.
senses.ms_definition: Catatan yang mengenal pasti sumber yang dipetik atau digunakan dalam sesuatu penulisan.
senses.nuances: 属于核心“参考来源”义在学术写作中的具体用法。senarai rujukan 通常指正文所引用来源的列表；具体格式依所用写作规范而定。[学术写作指南](https://fppi.uis.edu.my/images/pascasiswazah/buku-panduan-penulisan-ilmiah-gaya-kuis-peringkat-pascasiswazah.pdf)

senses.zh_definition: 供识别、追踪或对应某封公函、档案或事项的参考标识，尤其用于编号。
senses.en_definition: An identifying reference used to locate or track correspondence, a file, or a case.
senses.ms_definition: Pengenal yang digunakan untuk mengesan atau menghubungkan surat, fail atau sesuatu urusan.
senses.nuances: 常见于 nombor rujukan。公函中的 Rujukan kami 和 Rujukan tuan 分别对应发函方与收函方的有关档案参考编号，不表示学术参考文献。[马来西亚公共服务局公函指南](https://docs.jpa.gov.my/docs/myppsm/PPSM/PO/Pentadbiran-dan-Pengurusan-Pejabat/55/)

senses.zh_definition: 将个案交由另一位专业人员或另一机构进一步评估、处理或治疗；医疗语境指转诊。
senses.en_definition: A referral of a person or case to another professional or institution for assessment, treatment, or action.
senses.ms_definition: Penghantaran seseorang atau sesuatu kes kepada pihak lain untuk penilaian, rawatan atau tindakan lanjut.
senses.nuances: 这是行政与医疗领域的常见扩展用法。surat rujukan 在医疗场景是转诊信，不是求职推荐信；后者通常需按语境使用 surat sokongan 或 surat perakuan。[卫生部转诊政策用例](https://www.moh.gov.my/moh/modules_resources/database_stores/87/178.pdf)

etymology.historical_story: The base rujuk is an Arabic loan associated with returning. In Malay, its meanings include returning to an earlier position and consulting a source. Adding the Malay suffix -an produces rujukan, something one turns to for information. Modern academic, administrative, and medical usage extends this network to citations, identifying references, and referrals. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=115704&keyword=Rujuk)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: rujuk 是“回头查”，rujukan 是“拿来查的资料”；见到 surat rujukan，则把画面换成“带着信转给另一位医生”。

morphology.pattern_note: 按印尼语形态分析修正资料包的 root_word=rekaman、is_root=true：本词由 rekam 加名词后缀 -an 构成；词根辅音不变，/m/ 在音节划分中进入后续音节。马来西亚对应形式为 rakam + -an → rakaman。爪夷文缺乏核实，保留 null。

word_family.gloss: 录制或记录的过程；印尼语形式

senses.zh_definition: 录音、录像或其他记录所得的内容或制品；印尼语形式，马来西亚标准马来语通常写作 rakaman。
senses.en_definition: A recording or recorded result, especially captured sound or images; the Indonesian counterpart of Malaysian Malay rakaman.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam bahasa Indonesia, sesuatu yang direkam atau hasil merekam, khususnya bunyi atau gambar yang disimpan; padanan bahasa Melayu Malaysia ialah rakaman.
senses.nuances: 不是英语 record“纪录成绩”的通用对译，也不等同于表示录制过程的 perekaman。释义为综合编写，并非声称 DBP 为 rekaman 提供了逐字相同的马来语定义。DBP 的马来西亚词条为 rakaman；其跨地区术语资料也将 rekaman 列作印尼语对应形式。status 按指定格式保留，不表示 rekaman 是马来西亚推荐拼写。参见 [DBP：rakaman](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=rakaman)、[DBP：record 地区术语对照](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=115704&keyword=record)及 [KBBI：rekam](https://kbbi.web.id/rekam)。

etymology.historical_story: The Indonesian rekam family connects visible impressions, printed marks and embroidery with the preservation of sound and images. Rekaman names the resulting product through the suffix -an. This offers a memorable semantic bridge from a mark left on material to information retained for replay. Malaysian Malay normally uses the corresponding form rakaman. See [KBBI](https://kbbi.web.id/rekam) and [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=rakaman).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 rekam 是“录”，-an 指向“录下来的东西”；跨到马来西亚用语时，把整词配对为 rekaman → rakaman。

etymology.historical_story: The name comes from Romeo, the young lover in Shakespeare's Romeo and Juliet. A literary character thus became a label for a recognisable social type. Malay figurative usage gives the label a teasing or critical edge: a romeo enjoys courting women and may change girlfriends frequently. The dictionary meaning therefore extends beyond the play's celebrated romance. [Folger](https://www.folger.edu/explore/shakespeares-works/romeo-and-juliet/), [Malaysian usage](https://www.mstar.com.my/spotlight/hiburan/2010/03/25/saya-tak-cukup-romeo--jehan-miskin)

etymology.historical_story: Resepi is a common nonstandard spelling of Malaysian Malay resipi, borrowed from English recipe. The English word ultimately comes from Latin recipe, an instruction meaning 'take', familiar from medical prescriptions listing ingredients. A word associated with preparing remedies later became ordinary kitchen vocabulary. DBP prescribes resipi for standard Malay writing. [Wikikamus](https://ms.wiktionary.org/wiki/resipi), [Etymonline](https://www.etymonline.com/word/recipe), [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=resipi).

etymology.historical_story: Rebus belongs to the practical vocabulary of the Malay kitchen. Its word family distinguishes the action, merebus, from what has been boiled, rebusan, and the cooking process, perebusan. Everyday expressions such as telur rebus show how a cooking verb also becomes a compact description of food on a menu. See [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=54140&keyword=rebus).

etymology.historical_story: Rakannya is built from rakan and the attached third-person pronoun -nya, rather than borrowed as a complete word. Its cultural interest lies in the range of companionship: a rakan can share a playground, an office or a business venture. The same noun therefore connects personal company with practical cooperation, without necessarily implying intimacy.

etymology.historical_story: English river reached Middle English through French forms related to Latin ripa, meaning bank or shore. Its history connects the flowing water with the land beside it. This is a borrowed whole word in English, so its final letters do not function as the ordinary agent suffix -er. [Source: Dictionary.com](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/river).

etymology.historical_story: The sound sense of ring is naturally understood as an imitation of a clear ringing noise; DBP links it to dering. The same spelling also has a separate borrowed colloquial sense referring to rings or bands. These meanings should remain distinct: their shared spelling does not establish a single historical origin. [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=ring)

senses.zh_definition: 跑步；作为运动或锻炼项目的奔跑活动。
senses.en_definition: The activity or sport of moving rapidly on foot.

senses.zh_definition: 经营；管理；使企业、机构或活动持续运作的工作。
senses.en_definition: The management or operation of a business, organization or activity.
senses.ms_definition: Pengurusan atau pengendalian sesebuah perniagaan, organisasi atau kegiatan.
senses.nuances: 英语中常见于 the running of a business。马来语正式文本应根据语境使用 pengurusan、pengendalian 或 operasi。[英语释义](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/us/dictionary/english/running)

senses.zh_definition: 持续进行的；连续不断的。
senses.en_definition: Continuing over a period of time.
senses.ms_definition: Berterusan atau berlangsung sepanjang sesuatu tempoh.
senses.nuances: 属于英语修饰语用法，如 running commentary。译成马来语时须按完整搭配处理，不能一律译作 berlari。[英语释义](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/us/dictionary/english/running)

senses.zh_definition: 流动的；持续流出的，尤指水。
senses.en_definition: Flowing, especially of water supplied through pipes or taps.
senses.ms_definition: Mengalir, khususnya tentang air yang dibekalkan melalui paip.
senses.nuances: Running water 通常对应 air mengalir；涉及房屋设施时，也可能需要译成 bekalan air paip，突出供水设施。[英语释义](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/us/dictionary/english/running)

senses.zh_definition: 连续地；接连地，用于一段段相继发生的时间之后。
senses.en_definition: Consecutively; without an intervening break in a sequence.
senses.ms_definition: Berturut-turut tanpa sela antara tempoh yang disebut.
senses.nuances: 这是英语中置于时间短语之后的用法，如 three days running；马来语通常使用 berturut-turut。[英语释义](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/us/dictionary/english/running)

etymology.historical_story: Running belongs to the English family of run. English formed it with -ing, and its meanings expanded from physical movement to flowing water, continuing activity and management. In Malaysian conversation, the English form can appear inside a Malay sentence. Its presence there illustrates language mixing; it does not make -ing a productive Malay suffix. [Word history](https://www.etymonline.com/word/running)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先抓住 run 的“动起来”：人动是跑步，水动是流动，机器动是运转；具体译法看主语。

morphology.pattern_note: 单音节、未加词缀的名词，没有词缀引起的音变。未核实固定派生词，故不为填充词族而生造形式；也不要与英语 run 的过去式 ran 混淆。

senses.zh_definition: 搭建在树上的棚屋，可作住处，或供猎人等人临时遮蔽、歇息。
senses.en_definition: A hut built in a tree, used as a dwelling or as shelter, including by hunters.
senses.ms_definition: Pondok yang dibuat di atas pokok, sebagai tempat kediaman orang asli atau tempat pemburu berteduh.
senses.nuances: 释义依据资料包所引《Kamus Dewan》第四版，并将缩写展开。核心区别是棚屋位于树上，不泛指地面小屋或所有高脚屋。词典列举的用途不代表所有 Orang Asli 社群的居住方式。以下为教学搭配，未作语料频率排名。[DBP：ran](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=ran)

collocations.zh: 在树上棚屋里躲避风雨

etymology.historical_story: Kamus Dewan records ran as a hut built in a tree, connecting the word with dwellings and hunters’ shelters. Its cultural interest lies in this specific relationship between a structure, its location and its use. The cited definition supplies no historical derivation, so an earlier source language or date cannot responsibly be assigned. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=ran)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ran 的单音节“兰”与一棵树相连：树枝上架着小棚屋。只记“树上的棚屋”，不要联想到英语的“跑了”。

etymology.historical_story: Romi appears as a personal name in Malay literary culture, including Mahizan Husain's novel Romi dan Kucai. This documents the name's use, but does not establish its ultimate linguistic origin. The packet's geographical explanation belongs to Rom, a different entry; attaching that history to Romi would turn a database association into an unsupported etymology. [DBP literary discussion](https://wadahdbp.my/titisan-pena/pemikiran-kerohanian-mahizan-husain-dalam-novel-romi-dan-kucai/)

etymology.historical_story: Kamus Dewan records reti as conversational Malay and directs readers to erti. This links everyday knowing with the vocabulary of meaning and understanding. In ordinary conversation, the word can concern either grasping an explanation or knowing a practical skill. The dictionary cross-reference alone does not establish a precise historical sound change. See [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=reti).

morphology.pattern_note: ronda 加名词后缀 -an；相邻两个 a 分属不同音节，读 ron.da.an。root_word 与 root_jawi 按要求保留数据包值，实际词法词根为 ronda，而 rondaan 是派生名词。

senses.zh_definition: 为维持安全、秩序或检查情况而在某一区域巡回进行的巡逻、巡查。
senses.en_definition: A patrol or round made through an area to maintain security or inspect conditions.
senses.ms_definition: Perjalanan berkeliling untuk meronda; hasil meronda.
senses.nuances: 通常指巡逻活动或一次巡逻，可徒步或使用车辆、船只等。巡逻人员称 peronda；rondaan 本身不等于巡逻队，也不等于休闲散步。[DBP：ronda](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=123312&keyword=ronda)

etymology.historical_story: The base ronda belongs to the Portuguese loanword layer documented in Malay and Indonesian, with the meaning of patrols or rounds. Malay adds its productive suffix -an to form rondaan. The resulting word fits both professional security work and neighbourhood patrols, showing how a borrowed base becomes part of ordinary Malay word formation. [Contact languages in Indonesia and Malaysia](https://is.cuni.cz/studium/predmety/index.php?did=279222&do=download&kod=AEIN100087)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ronda 联想到 round：绕区域一圈巡查；加 -an，就得到“一次巡逻、巡逻活动”rondaan。

senses.zh_definition: 节奏；音乐、舞蹈或动作中有规律的强弱与拍点组织。
senses.en_definition: A rhythmic pattern or beat in music, dance, or movement.
senses.ms_definition: Pola gerakan atau bunyi yang teratur dalam muzik, tarian atau pergerakan.
senses.nuances: 通常读 /rəntak/。侧重节拍和律动，不完全等同于旋律 melodi，也不单指速度 tempo。[DBP 释义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=244840&keyword=rentak)。

collocations.en: follow the beat of the music

senses.zh_definition: 跺脚或脚重重落地的动作、声响，尤指生气时的跺脚。

senses.ms_definition: Hentakan kaki yang kuat, terutama ketika marah.

senses.zh_definition: 比喻做事的节奏、方式或行为路数。
senses.en_definition: A characteristic pace, manner, or pattern of behaviour.
senses.ms_definition: Gaya, cara bertindak atau pola perjalanan sesuatu kegiatan.

etymology.historical_story: Malay dictionaries record rentak both for a foot stamp and for musical rhythm, alongside a figurative sense involving behaviour. These meanings offer a useful cultural connection: feet, instruments and dancers can share an organised pulse. Treat that connection as an explanation of related meanings, rather than proof of a particular historical origin. The separately pronounced réntak concerns a sharp pull.

etymology.historical_story: In Malay descriptions of timber and cloth, reput names the moment familiar materials lose their strength through deterioration. Its dictionary family turns that everyday observation into a small account of change: mereput describes becoming rotten, reputan names decayed matter, and pereputan names the process. These relationships are documented in [DBP's entry](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=reput).

etymology.historical_story: Rebah is treated here as a Malay root, without assigning it an unverified ancient source. Its physical image is an upright body or tree falling flat. Malay proverbial language carries that image into social life: berpecah membawa rebah presents division as a cause of downfall. A concrete change in posture thus becomes a memorable image for collective failure.

etymology.historical_story: Reynolds entered Malay technical vocabulary through scientific naming rather than Malay word formation. The Reynolds number commemorates Osborne Reynolds and compares inertial with viscous effects in fluid flow. His surname consequently appears in engineering classrooms and reports, where Malay supplies the surrounding terminology while retaining the personal name. [NASA](https://www.nasa.gov/altitude-wind-tunnel-how-the-facility-worked/)

etymology.historical_story: Roosevelt comes from the Dutch family name Rosenvelt, meaning 'rose field'. Its landscape meaning belongs to the surname's history, rather than to Malay vocabulary. In Malay historical writing, Roosevelt remains a personal name, so identifying the individual matters more than translating its literal origin. The surname alone does not distinguish Theodore from Franklin. [Source: FDR Presidential Library](https://www.fdrlibrary.org/es/roosevelt-family).

senses.ms_definition: Dalam percakapan atau iklan bercampur bahasa Inggeris, sudah disediakan atau tersedia untuk digunakan, diambil atau diserahkan.
senses.nuances: 常用于餐饮、网购和工作聊天。ready stock 指已有现货，不等于已经寄出；barang dah ready 表示货品备妥，也不自动表示已付款或已交付。

dual_scenarios.en: In an official report, replace 'ready' with 'bersedia' or 'siap', depending on the context.

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 与熟悉的双语朋友或同事聊天时很自然。面向公众、长辈或不熟悉英语的对象，使用 bersedia 或 siap 更清楚；正式文件采用标准马来语。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合聊天、口头协调和非正式商家沟通。正式例句将 ready 作为被讨论的英语词引用。询问对方进度时，Awak dah ready? 比直接催促更缓和。

etymology.historical_story: Ready is an English word used within Malay conversation through language contact and everyday bilingual practice. Speakers can place it inside Malay sentence patterns, as in dah ready or ready nak pergi. It is useful for quick coordination, but formal Malay expresses the same ideas with words such as bersedia, siap, and tersedia.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 听到 ready，就接上“准备好了”：人 ready 是 bersedia，东西 ready 常是 sudah siap。

morphology.pattern_note: 阿拉伯语整词借入，现代马来语中作为独立词根记忆；结尾 -lah 不是语气词或后缀。

senses.zh_definition: 向公众或特定群体分发的简短印刷资料；传单、宣传单。
senses.en_definition: A leaflet or circular distributed to convey information.
senses.ms_definition: Surat edaran atau bahan siaran ringkas yang diedarkan kepada orang ramai.

senses.en_definition: A short written work or booklet on a particular subject.
senses.ms_definition: Karangan atau rencana ringkas mengenai sesuatu perkara.
senses.nuances: 侧重内容简明、主题集中，可有数页，并不限于单张纸。risalah ujian 指考试论文的用法带有印度尼西亚语标记，不宜作为马来西亚日常核心义。

senses.zh_definition: 古典语境中受遣送出的书信、音信或传达之物。
senses.en_definition: In classical usage, a letter, message, or other communication sent.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam bahasa sastera lama, sesuatu yang diutuskan atau dikirimkan, seperti surat atau utusan.
senses.nuances: 属于古典书面语。现代日常交流通常直接使用 surat 或 pesanan；下列搭配适用于文学及历史语境。

senses.zh_definition: 宗教语境中使者传达的教义、使命；亦指使者的身份或职分。

senses.ms_definition: Seruan agama yang disampaikan oleh rasul, atau taraf dan tugas kerasulan.
senses.nuances: 用于伊斯兰宗教论述。risalah kenabian 不指普通宣传单，应按先知使命或教义理解。

etymology.historical_story: Risalah comes from Arabic risālah, associated with a letter or message. Its Malay meanings preserve a bridge between communication and religious mission: it can describe a prophetic message, a short treatise, or an everyday leaflet. The same word therefore connects religious writing with information handed out at a modern community event. [DBP：risalah](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=25872&keyword=risalah)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ri-sa-lah 的三个音节想成小册子的三次翻页：一页一条信息，合起来就是 risalah。

morphology.pattern_note: 在马来语中作为完整外来专名使用，不分析成 ri- 与 -co；规范行文首字母大写。音标为姓名的常见来源语读法，实际读法以本人为准。

etymology.historical_story: Rico brings together several naming histories. As a given name, it can shorten Ricardo, Enrico and other names containing rico. As a surname, Spanish and Portuguese traditions may connect it with a nickname meaning rich, while Italian examples may derive from shortened personal names. These possibilities require context when interpreting an individual name. [Given name](https://www.behindthename.com/name/rico), [Surname](https://www.familysearch.org/en/surname?surname=RICO).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 按“里—科”两拍记音，想象同事 Rico 的姓名牌；先识别人名，再由语境判断它是名字还是姓氏。

morphology.pattern_note: 后缀 -an 构成集合名词，词干辅音保持不变，ng 表示 /ŋ/。输入将 rombongan 标为词根；依据 DBP 将它列在 rombong II 下的派生关系，此处更正为非词根，root_jawi 相应改为 رومبوڠ。

word_family.gloss: 结队；成团；与 rombongan 结合时不重复词首 r

senses.zh_definition: 为共同工作、出行、访问或参加活动而结伴的一群人；依语境可指代表团、访问团、旅行团或随行人员。
senses.en_definition: A group of people travelling, visiting, working or attending an activity together; a party, delegation or entourage.
senses.ms_definition: Sekumpulan orang yang bekerja, datang, melawat atau melakukan sesuatu bersama-sama.
senses.nuances: 强调共同参与或同行的一群人，不必有正式组织身份，也不专指旅游团；通常不用于物品集合。文化演出语境可指演出团体。词义及 rombong II 的派生关系见 [DBP：rombong](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=rombong)。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 属于中性词，正式和日常交流均可使用。接待时可说 Selamat datang kepada ahli rombongan，礼貌欢迎全体团员。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 在一些马来提亲习俗中，rombongan meminang 由亲属组成，并由代表发言；实际安排依家庭和地方习俗而异，宜事先确认人数、时间及发言代表。[玻璃市公共图书馆：提亲习俗](https://www.perlislib.gov.my/web/ejurnal-perlis/172-adat-perkahwinan-masyarakat-meminang)。

etymology.historical_story: DBP places rombongan under rombong II, alongside merombong, meaning to gather into a group. The suffix -an gives the collective noun. A memorable cultural setting is the rombongan meminang: relatives attend a marriage proposal together, with a representative speaking for the party. The separate dictionary sense of rombong as a basket does not establish a basket-based origin.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rombongan 记成“一团同行的人”：学校参观是一团，正式出访也是一团。

morphology.pattern_note: 作为科学借词整词记忆；其中 radio- 是国际科学构词成分，不是本词的马来语生产性前缀。词末 f 保留。

word_family.gloss: 放射性；自发发射电离辐射的性质
具有放射性的；含放射性物质的

senses.zh_definition: 具有放射性的；含有会因原子核自发衰变而发出电离辐射的物质的，或与这类物质有关的。
senses.en_definition: Exhibiting, containing, or relating to substances that emit ionizing radiation through spontaneous nuclear decay.
senses.ms_definition: Berkaitan dengan atau mengandungi bahan yang memancarkan sinaran mengion melalui pereputan nukleus secara spontan.
senses.nuances: radioaktif 是形容词；表示这种性质的名词是 keradioaktifan。不要把普通无线电波与放射性混为一谈，也不要据此断言所有放射性物质都同样危险。马来西亚专业用语实例见 [马来西亚核能机构](https://www.nuclearmalaysia.gov.my/penerbitan/dbp/dbp.php)。

cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于科研、工业、环境报道及相关标识。不要用它嘲讽病人或接受相关检查、治疗的人，也不要把普通异味或污染随意称为 radioaktif。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 这是科学和监管语域中的中性词。向公众说明时，宜明确物质、检测结果及语境，避免只用一个标签制造恐慌。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适用于科研、工业、环境报道及相关标识。不要用它嘲讽病人或接受相关检查、治疗的人，也不要把普通异味或污染随意称为 radioaktif。

etymology.historical_story: Radioaktif belongs to the international scientific vocabulary associated with discoveries of spontaneous radiation in the late nineteenth century. Its radio- element ultimately evokes Latin radius, meaning a ray. Becquerel discovered the phenomenon in 1896, and Marie Curie subsequently named it radioactivity. The Malay spelling fits this international terminology into familiar written forms. [CEA](https://www.cea.fr/comprendre/Pages/radioactivite/radioactivite.aspx)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 读 ra-dio-ak-tif，抓住 aktif（活跃）：想象原子核自发放出射线，记住“具有放射性”；这是记忆画面，不是把收音机当作放射源。

etymology.historical_story: The currency name reaches back to South Asian words associated with worked silver and coins. Sher Shah Suri's sixteenth-century silver rupee helped establish a denomination later consolidated under the Mughals. English adds its ordinary plural ending to produce rupees; Malay dictionaries instead list rupee, showing how one currency name follows different grammatical systems. [Oxford: A Silvered Past](https://ora.ox.ac.uk/objects/uuid%3A9f3a9484-9adc-4220-8d84-f2489322b218/files/rb8515q10h)；[DBP: rupee](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=rupee)

etymology.historical_story: English rogue has an uncertain origin. Historical uses include a vagrant or dishonest person, while later uses can describe an affectionate rascal or something operating outside normal control. Its gaming sense draws on the familiar image of a cunning outsider. In Malay conversation, retaining rogue generally signals English terminology or a game label. etymology.historical_story: Malay uses rahang for the bodily jaw and extends the same image to mechanical parts that grip objects. The expression keras rahang turns physical hardness into an image of refusing to yield. Separately, Pahang dialect records a homonym for an unpleasant aftertaste; the dictionary evidence does not establish a shared origin for that regional adjective. etymology.historical_story: English rain continues Middle English rein and Old English regn, with relatives such as Dutch regen and German Regen. Its appearance inside a Malaysian message can reflect English quotation or language mixing. That contemporary setting does not by itself establish a Malay borrowing: the standard Malay weather word remains hujan. [English word history](https://www.etymonline.com/word/rain); [Malaysian weather terminology](https://developer.data.gov.my/realtime-api/weather).

etymology.historical_story: Rasional belongs to an international family associated with reason, ultimately connected with Latin ratio through forms such as rationalis. Malay uses one spelling for two functions that English distinguishes as rational and rationale. That pairing is especially useful in reports: a decision can be rasional, while its supporting explanation is also called its rasional. [Latin background](https://www.ahdictionary.com/word/search.html?q=rational); [DBP meanings](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=rasional)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 一个 rasional，记住两个英语伙伴：评价决定时是 rational（理性的）；解释决定时是 rationale（理由）。

etymology.historical_story: The English tree name rowan is of Scandinavian origin. Beyond botany, the tree became associated with protection in northern European folklore: people planted it near homes or used its branches as charms. Such stories concern cultural beliefs, not botanical properties. In Malay descriptions, retaining rowan alongside Sorbus aucuparia helps readers identify the tree without confusing it with unrelated trees called ash. [American Heritage Dictionary](https://ahdictionary.com/word/search.html?q=rowan) [Woodland Trust](https://www.woodlandtrust.org.uk/trees-woods-and-wildlife/british-trees/a-z-of-british-trees/rowan/)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rowan 的开头联想成英语 row“一排”：羽状复叶的小叶排成两行，枝头挂着一簇簇红果。此为记忆联想，并非词源。

etymology.historical_story: Rambutmu is a transparent possessive expression rather than a separate borrowed word: rambut names head hair, and -mu identifies its owner as the person addressed. Its compact shape suits direct address in writing and intimate speech. The same pattern also produces rambutku and rambutnya, making one familiar noun a useful guide to Malay possession.

etymology.historical_story: English rich descends through Middle English riche from Old English rīce. Its early history connects wealth with power and high social standing. Later meanings extend abundance to food, colour, and sound. In a Malay sentence, rich remains an English insertion; its appearance in DBP’s English–Malay dictionary does not establish it as a standard Malay headword. Sources: [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/rich), [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Search?k=rich).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记住共同核心“含量足”：钱多是富有，营养多是富含，奶油多是浓腻；rich 的 ch 收成 /tʃ/，不另加一个音节。

etymology.historical_story: Resit is a borrowing from English receipt, adapted to Malay spelling and pronunciation. The English word contains a silent p, while the Malay form represents the spoken consonants more directly. Its familiar setting is the exchange at a shop counter: payment changes hands, and a written acknowledgement records that it has been received.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 resit 与英语 receipt 成对记：付款后拿到的那张凭证，就是 resit；马来语拼写没有英语中的不发音 p。

etymology.historical_story: The royal title rani belongs to an Indic naming tradition: Hindi rānī is traced to Sanskrit rājñī, the feminine counterpart of rājan, meaning king. This explains its historical relationship with raja. It does not establish the immediate route into Malay or the origins of the separate wealth and musical homonyms. [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/rani)

etymology.historical_story: Rizvan belongs to the wider name tradition associated with Arabic riḍwān, meaning approval or good pleasure. Related names appear with different spellings across languages, reflecting different ways of representing sounds. That shared background does not establish an individual bearer’s ancestry or preferred pronunciation. In Malay conversation, the name identifies a person rather than translating the Arabic abstract noun. [Arabic lexical background](https://corpus.quran.com/qurandictionary.jsp?q=rDw)

etymology.historical_story: Resipi is a Malay adaptation of English recipe. The English word ultimately comes from Latin recipe, an instruction meaning 'take', traditionally used when listing ingredients for a preparation. That practical pattern also supports a metaphor: success can have ingredients and a method, just as a cake does. See [resipi etymology](https://ms.wiktionary.org/wiki/resipi).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把英语 recipe 换成马来语的三个清晰音节 re-si-pi：材料加步骤，就是食谱；把材料换成努力与合作，就是成功配方。

morphology.pattern_note: -kan 使形容词 rendah 构成及物动词，表示“使变低”；词根不变，e 读 /ə/。常用于祈使句，也见于 saya rendahkan 等第一人称被动结构。输入 Jawi رنده 对应词根，完整形式可写作 رندهکن。

senses.en_definition: To reduce volume, degree, level, standard or quality.
senses.ms_definition: Mengurangkan kekuatan suara atau menurunkan sesuatu tahap, nilai, standard atau mutu.
senses.nuances: 具体含义取决于宾语：rendahkan suara 通常是轻声说话；rendahkan mutu 则是降低质量，常带负面评价。陈述主动行为时通常使用 merendahkan。[依据：DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=rendah)。

senses.zh_definition: 贬低；轻视某人、某种能力或某项贡献。
senses.en_definition: To belittle someone or disparage their abilities, worth or contribution.
senses.ms_definition: Menganggap atau memperlakukan seseorang atau sesuatu sebagai tidak penting, tidak bernilai atau tidak berkemampuan.
senses.nuances: 涉及人的尊严时语气较强，常见于 jangan rendahkan orang lain。不要把它与表示谦逊的 rendahkan hati 混淆。[依据：DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=rendah)。

senses.zh_definition: 在 rendahkan hati 或特定语境的 rendahkan diri 中，表示放下傲气、保持谦逊。
senses.en_definition: In expressions with hati or diri, to adopt a humble, unassuming attitude.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam ungkapan dengan hati atau diri, bersikap tidak sombong dan tidak meninggikan diri.
senses.nuances: 这是搭配义，并非 rendahkan 单独使用时就表示“谦虚”。rendahkan diri 也可能指压低身体或自我贬低，须根据上下文判断。[依据：DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=rendah)。

etymology.historical_story: Rendahkan shows a productive Malay pattern: rendah describes something low, while -kan expresses making it lower. The physical image extends to voices, standards and social standing. This explains why the same family can describe adjusting a chair, speaking softly or belittling someone, with the object determining the meaning. [Source: DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=rendah).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: rendah＝低，-kan＝使变成：rendahkan 就是“使变低”。声音变低是轻声，人的价值被压低就是贬低。

etymology.historical_story: Raftaar represents raftār, a Persian-origin word used in Urdu and Hindi for speed, pace, or movement. Its appearance in a Malay-language collection may reflect quotation or a name rather than an established borrowing. etymology.historical_story: Rimba evokes more than a stand of trees in Malay cultural expression. In pantun and proverbial language, the forest provides images of distance, concealment and the natural world. Expressions such as rimba raya and rimba dara preserve that evocative force, while modern conservation writing uses the same word for forests valued as living habitats.

etymology.historical_story: Rantaian develops the image of rantai, a chain, through the noun-forming suffix -an. Connected links provide a useful image for connected events and processes. Modern expressions apply that image to food, supplies, and value creation. The older expression orang rantaian preserves a harsher association: people restrained with chains. [DBP: rantaian](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Search?k=rantaian)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 rantai＝链，再加 -an：把一个个环节串成 rantaian。

morphology.pattern_note: is_root 与 root_word 保留输入包的词表标记；实际构词可分析为 risik 加名词后缀 -an。risik 的词尾 k 常读作 [ʔ]，接元音起首的后缀后读作 [k]。

senses.zh_definition: 为查明情况而秘密进行的探查、侦察或调查。
senses.en_definition: Discreet or covert investigation undertaken to discover information.
senses.ms_definition: Penyelidikan atau penyiasatan secara sulit untuk mengetahui sesuatu perkara.
senses.nuances: 侧重秘密搜集信息的过程，常见于警务、军事及安全语境；普通公开调查通常用 penyiasatan 或 kajian。DBP 在 risik 词条中将 risikan 列为同义形式。[DBP：risik](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=113780&keyword=risik)

senses.zh_definition: 通过秘密调查或隐蔽渠道取得的情报、线索或消息。
senses.en_definition: Information obtained through discreet inquiries or covert investigation.
senses.ms_definition: Maklumat atau keterangan yang diperoleh melalui penyiasatan secara rahsia.
senses.nuances: 侧重搜集到的信息，而非执行任务的人。perisik 指情报人员，risikan 指活动或所得情报；情报仍须核实，不能自动视为已证实的事实。

dual_scenarios.ms: Berdasarkan risikan awal, pihak polis mengenal pasti sebuah gudang yang disyaki digunakan untuk menyimpan barangan curi.
dual_scenarios.zh: 警方根据初步情报，锁定了一座涉嫌用于存放赃物的仓库。
dual_scenarios.en: Acting on preliminary intelligence, police identified a warehouse suspected of being used to store stolen goods.
