spoken_features: dah 是 sudah 的口语形式
sikit 对应 sedikit，tu 对应 itu
省略主语；rupanya 表示新近发现
把侦察用语用于打听店铺消息，带轻松诙谐语气

cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 涉及他人私事时，使用这个词容易让对方觉得被监视。普通咨询可用 bertanya 或 mendapatkan maklumat；risikan 也不应与未经核实的流言混为一谈。

etymology.historical_story: DBP connects risikan with risik, a word associated with discovering information discreetly. The same lexical family includes merisik, which can describe preliminary inquiries about a prospective marriage. This offers a memorable cultural connection between confidential investigation and tactful family inquiries, without implying that intelligence work historically originated in marriage customs. [DBP: risik](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=113780&keyword=risik)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ri-si-kan 分成三拍，想象“悄悄问、细细查、拿情报”；联系 merisik 的“暗中探询”一起记。

senses.en_definition: Possibly the personal name Reiko; the intended referent and lexical identity remain unconfirmed.
senses.ms_definition: Bentuk ini mungkin merujuk kepada nama orang, Reiko; identiti dan maksudnya dalam bahan asal belum dapat dipastikan.
senses.nuances: 此处 noun 仅适用于人名这一条件性解释。东京外国语大学的马来语教学材料使用 Reiko 作为人名，但这不能证明输入语料中的 reiko 必然指同一人。下列为人名用法示例，不是已核实的高频搭配。

etymology.historical_story: Reiko appears as a personal name in Malay teaching material published by Tokyo University of Foreign Studies. Names can enter a Malay corpus without becoming ordinary Malay vocabulary. A romanized Japanese name may correspond to different written forms, so neither its original characters nor its meaning can be recovered reliably from this isolated lowercase token.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先把 reiko 放进“可能的人名”格：记住名字，不从字母拼出未经证实的词义。

morphology.formula: ∅ + resync → resync（按输入包作为独立词条处理）
morphology.pattern_note: 不是已核实的马来语词根。英语内部可分析为 re- + sync，表示再次同步；这不是马来语加缀。英语读音中，字母组合 nc 对应 /ŋk/。

word_family.gloss: 英语同族词：同步；synchronize 的缩略形式

senses.zh_definition: 重新同步，使数据、设备或音视频恢复一致或时间对齐。
senses.en_definition: To synchronize again or restore synchronization.
senses.ms_definition: Menyegerakkan semula data, peranti atau unsur audio dan video supaya kembali sepadan.
senses.nuances: 英语技术用语，可出现在马来西亚职场的语码转换中；正式马来语可表述为 menyegerakkan semula。这里的马来语释义为编写释义，并非 DBP 原文；未核实其为正式马来语词条，因此不标记 official。技术用法参见 [BMC RESYNC 文档](https://docs.bmc.com/xwiki/bin/view/Mainframe/Data-for-IMS/Fast-PathEP-products-reference-information/FPEPSerRfMn/Command-language/Commands-and-subcommands/RESYNC/)。下列搭配采用马来语对应表达。

dual_scenarios.context: 职场技术汇报；说明英语操作名称
dual_scenarios.ms: Operasi yang dilabelkan sebagai "resync" akan menyegerakkan semula data antara kedua-dua pelayan.
dual_scenarios.zh: 标为“resync”的操作将重新同步两台服务器之间的数据。
dual_scenarios.en: The operation labelled “resync” will synchronize the data between the two servers again.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 同事之间的技术交流；含英语语码转换
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Cuba resync fail tu dulu, lepas tu semak balik.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Cuba segerakkan semula fail itu dahulu, kemudian semak sekali lagi.
dual_scenarios.zh: 先试着把那个文件重新同步，再检查一下。
dual_scenarios.en: Try resyncing that file first, then check it again.
spoken_features: resync：英语技术动词嵌入马来语句子
tu → itu
lepas tu → kemudian
semak balik → semak sekali lagi

messages.speaker: Farah (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Fail kat telefon saya tak sama dengan yang kat komputer. Nak resync sekarang ke?
messages.ms_standard: Fail pada telefon saya tidak sama dengan fail pada komputer. Perlukah saya menyegerakkannya semula sekarang?
messages.zh: 我手机上的文件和电脑上的不一样。现在要重新同步吗？
messages.en: The file on my phone doesn’t match the one on my computer. Should I resync it now?

messages.speaker: Amir (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Ya, resync dulu je. Lepas tu beritahu saya kalau masih tak sama.
messages.ms_standard: Ya, segerakkannya semula dahulu. Kemudian, beritahu saya jika fail itu masih tidak sepadan.
messages.zh: 对，先重新同步一下。之后要是还不一样，再告诉我。
messages.en: Yes, just resync it first. Let me know if it still doesn’t match.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 熟悉技术的同事之间可使用 resync；面向客户、公众或正式马来语文件时，使用 menyegerakkan semula 更清楚。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 首次出现时可写 resync（menyegerakkan semula）。口语中的 je、tu 和省略形式适合熟人交流；正式操作说明宜使用完整表达。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 熟悉技术的同事之间可使用 resync；面向客户、公众或正式马来语文件时，使用 menyegerakkan semula 更清楚。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 首次出现时可写 resync（menyegerakkan semula）。口语中的 je、tu 和省略形式适合熟人交流；正式操作说明宜使用完整表达。

etymology.historical_story: English resync combines re-, meaning again, with sync, a shortened form associated with synchronization. Its transparent structure suits technical instructions: when two copies or signals cease to agree, they can be brought into alignment again. This explains the expression without treating it as a Malay formation. Technical usage is illustrated in [BMC documentation](https://docs.bmc.com/xwiki/bin/view/Mainframe/Data-for-IMS/Fast-PathEP-products-reference-information/FPEPSerRfMn/Command-language/Commands-and-subcommands/RESYNC/).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 听成“ree-SINK”：re- 是“再一次”，sync 是“同步”；两台设备重新对齐，就是 resync。

morphology.formula: ∅ + reacher → reacher（作为外语整词处理）
morphology.pattern_note: 未核实为马来语正式普通词，不能标为 official。英语内部可分析为 reach + -er；这不是马来语构词。音标采用非卷舌英语读音，音节划分为补充分析。

word_family.gloss: 伸手够取的动作；正在够取

senses.zh_definition: 英语名词：够取东西的人或工具；在辅助器具语境中，尤其指帮助使用者夹取远处或低处物件的长柄取物器。
senses.en_definition: A person or implement that reaches; especially a long-handled gripping aid for picking up otherwise inaccessible objects.
senses.ms_definition: Istilah bahasa Inggeris bagi orang atau alat yang mencapai sesuatu, khususnya alat bertangkai panjang untuk mengambil barang yang sukar dicapai.
senses.nuances: 这里提供的是英语词的马来文解释，并非DBP官方释义。下列搭配属于含英语术语的马来语表达，不声称为已确立的高频马来语搭配。器具义参见[辅助器具释义](https://www.disabilityhelp.org/glossary/reacher/)。

senses.zh_definition: 专名Reacher：可指虚构人物杰克·雷彻的姓氏，也用于相关作品名称。
senses.en_definition: Reacher, the surname of the fictional character Jack Reacher, also used in titles of works featuring him.
senses.ms_definition: Nama keluarga watak fiksyen Jack Reacher, yang turut digunakan dalam judul karya tentang watak tersebut.
senses.nuances: 专名应写作Reacher，不能根据输入的小写形式断定具体指哪部作品。人物与系列名称可核对[出版社的Jack Reacher系列页面](https://www.penguinrandomhouse.com/series/JAC/jack-reacher/)。本义的马来文释义为编写说明。

dual_scenarios.en: A long-handled gripping aid, called a reacher in English, helps users pick up objects without bending down.

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 向不熟悉英语术语的对象介绍时，先说alat pengambil barang bertangkai panjang，再补充reacher，便于理解。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 器具义可用于产品或日常交流；人物、姓氏和作品名称保留大写。不能把英语使用证据当作马来语官方收录证据。

etymology.historical_story: English reacher transparently combines reach with the agent or instrument suffix -er. Its tool sense names something that extends a person's reach, such as a gripping aid. Capitalized Reacher also names Lee Child's fictional hero. These English uses do not establish official Malay adoption. See the [tool description](https://www.disabilityhelp.org/glossary/reacher/) and [publisher's series page](https://www.penguinrandomhouse.com/series/JAC/jack-reacher/).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记英语reach＝伸手够取，再记reacher＝帮你够到东西的人或工具；大写Reacher则可能是人名。

morphology.formula: ∅ + Rudra → Rudra（梵语来源专名，整词记忆）
morphology.pattern_note: 未核实为DBP正式普通词，不能标为 official。这里按宗教专名解释，规范书写首字母大写；不套用马来语词缀。音标为按马来语字母读法补充的宽式读音，不代表已核实的官方读音或梵语原音。

senses.zh_definition: 楼陀罗：吠陀传统中的神祇，具有威猛、风暴及护佑等特征，在后来的印度教传统中与湿婆密切关联。
senses.en_definition: Rudra, a Vedic deity associated with fierce and protective powers and closely identified with Shiva in later Hindu tradition.
senses.ms_definition: Nama dewa dalam tradisi Veda yang mempunyai sifat garang serta melindungi, dan dikaitkan erat dengan Shiva dalam perkembangan agama Hindu.
senses.nuances: 此处pos=noun涵盖专有名词，不能理解为普通名词“风暴”或“愤怒”。马来文释义为编写说明，并非DBP引文。宗教背景参见[Oxford：Rudra–Shiva](https://academic.oup.com/reference/62357/reference-article-abstract/554515949)。孤立的小写词形也可能对应人名或作品名，原始语境不足以确定。

dual_scenarios.context: 学术汇报 / 宗教文化介绍

dual_scenarios.en: The paper examines the relationship between Rudra in the Vedic tradition and Shiva in the development of Hinduism.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 朋友讨论宗教文化读物
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Nama Rudra ni ada kaitan dengan Shiva ke?

dual_scenarios.zh: Rudra这个名字跟湿婆有关吗？

nak相当于hendak。

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Nama Rudra ni ada kaitan dengan Shiva ke?
messages.ms_standard: Adakah nama Rudra ini mempunyai kaitan dengan Shiva?
messages.zh: Rudra这个名字跟湿婆有关吗？

messages.speaker: Priya (朋友)

etymology.historical_story: Rudra is a Sanskrit divine name, conventionally interpreted as the howler or roarer. Vedic accounts combine his frightening powers with appeals for protection, including protection of cattle. Later Hindu traditions closely identify Rudra with Shiva. This history explains the religious name; it does not make rudra a Malay adjective meaning fierce. See the [historical encyclopaedia entry](https://www.studylight.org/encyclopedias/eng/bri/r/rudra.html).

etymology.historical_story: The supplied evidence establishes rajin as a Malay root but does not establish its ultimate historical origin. Its meanings connect diligence with repeated action: someone who is rajin works earnestly, while someone who is rajin ke masjid goes frequently. This bridge helps explain why the same word can praise effort or describe a habit.

etymology.historical_story: Rambutku combines the everyday noun rambut with the bound pronoun -ku, related to aku. Its personal tone makes it useful in intimate speech, songs, and first-person writing. The same attachment pattern appears in words such as rumahku and namaku: possession is expressed within one written word rather than through a separate possessive adjective.

etymology.historical_story: Raga connects everyday craft with traditional play: woven strips form a carrying basket or a ball kept aloft by skilful kicks. Dictionaries separately record raga meaning body, marked as Javanese, and another base behind words for displaying. These matching spellings preserve different lexical histories; the basket should not be explained as a simple metaphorical ancestor of every other meaning.

etymology.historical_story: Resort is an English word used in Malaysian tourism alongside the Malay expression pusat peranginan. Its local setting is easy to recognise: beach holidays, island accommodation, and leisure facilities marketed together. Malaysia's tourism ministry explicitly pairs Pusat Peranginan with Resort in its project categories. That institutional pairing documents its practical industry use without establishing when the word first entered local speech. [Source](https://www.motac.gov.my/pendaftaran-projek-pelancongan/)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把熟悉的英语 resort 直接连到“住宿＋休闲＋度假”；正式马来语对应 pusat peranginan，整词记忆即可。

morphology.pattern_note: -nya 在这里是第三人称领属附着语，表示某个国家、统治者或领导者的人民；不是派生新词的普通后缀。词根读 /raʔ.jat/，也有保留 /ʕ/ 的读法；ny 表示 /ɲ/。输入未提供音节，故保留 null；可分析为 rak.yat.nya。输入 Jawi رعيت 仅对应 rakyat，完整 rakyatnya 应加 ڽ，写作 رعيتڽ。

etymology.historical_story: Rakyat is an Arabic-derived word associated with the people governed by a ruler. Its Malay meanings preserve several social settings: a country's population, a leader's followers, ordinary people, and troops in older narratives. Rakyatnya adds the Malay enclitic -nya, linking those people to a country or ruler already mentioned. See [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=Rakyat) and [linguistic research](https://scispace.com/pdf/islamic-cultural-and-arabic-linguistic-influence-on-the-2lhzq96aqn.pdf).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: rakyat 是“人民”，后面的 /ɲa/ 像贴上的“其”字标签：rakyat + nya＝其人民。

etymology.historical_story: A small disturbance on water gives riak a vivid image for remembering its figurative sense: a slight facial movement can reveal an inward feeling. This is a teaching connection, not a proven chronology of semantic change. Dictionaries separately record riak meaning phlegm and an older form referring to ostentation; those homonyms should not be given an invented common origin. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=74812&keyword=riak); [Kamus Dewan](https://iqwiens.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/01/kamus-dewan.pdf)

etymology.historical_story: Ronny belongs to an international personal-name tradition rather than Malay derivational vocabulary. Sweden's Institute for Language and Folklore identifies it as originally an English familiar form of Ronald and notes its use as an independent given name. This naming history does not establish any particular Malaysian bearer's ancestry, religion, preferred pronunciation, or full legal name.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: Ronny 可先记作“罗尼”这个名字；记住人名身份，不把名字的历史来源当成本人的字面含义。

morphology.pattern_note: 国家专名，规范书写为 Romania。词尾 -ia 不是本词中的马来语派生后缀；没有可据此建立的常用马来语派生词族。

senses.zh_definition: 罗马尼亚：位于欧洲东南部的国家，首都为布加勒斯特。
senses.en_definition: Romania, a country in southeastern Europe whose capital is Bucharest.
senses.ms_definition: Sebuah negara di tenggara Eropah yang beribu kota di Bucharest.
senses.nuances: 属于国家专名，正文中应大写为 Romania；小写键名仅保留输入形式。这里的 official 表示规范使用的国名，不表示 PRPM 另有同形普通词词条。马来语释义为编辑概述。参见 [DBP 百科中的 Romania](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=Romania)。

etymology.historical_story: Romania's name is connected with Romanian român, meaning Romanian, and ultimately with Latin Romanus, meaning Roman. The name preserves a link to Roman history and the Latin ancestry of the Romanian language. Malay uses Romania as a country name; its ending is part of the borrowed name rather than a productive Malay suffix.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 从 Romania 中的 Roman 联想到“罗马”，再记住：Romania 是罗马尼亚，首都是 Bucharest。

morphology.pattern_note: 整词借入，无可分析的马来语词缀；末尾 -us 不是马来语后缀。音节字段保留输入包的 ra.dius。

senses.zh_definition: 射线；光线。词典收录的义项，现代日常表达通常用 sinar。
senses.en_definition: A ray or beam of light; an uncommon sense in contemporary everyday Malay.
senses.ms_definition: Sinar atau pancaran cahaya.
senses.nuances: 输入包所引《Kamus Dewan》列有此义，但不宜据此编造高频 radius 光线搭配。以下提供表达此义更自然的 sinar 搭配。

senses.zh_definition: 半径：连接圆心与圆周上一点的线段，亦指其长度；球体中指球心至球面上一点的距离。
senses.en_definition: A line segment from the centre of a circle or sphere to its boundary, or the length of that segment.
senses.ms_definition: Jejari, iaitu garis dari pusat bulatan atau sfera ke sempadannya, atau panjang garis tersebut.
senses.nuances: 马来西亚数学教学通常使用 jejari。radius 可理解，但不要与 diameter（直径）混淆；直径等于半径的两倍。参见 [DBP：radius](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=radius)。

senses.zh_definition: 范围半径：从某一中心点向周围计算的距离界限，常用于搜索、服务覆盖或规划范围。
senses.en_definition: A specified distance extending outward from a central point, used to delimit an area.
senses.ms_definition: Jarak dari sesuatu titik pusat yang digunakan untuk menetapkan lingkungan sesuatu kawasan.
senses.nuances: dalam radius lima kilometer 指距中心不超过五公里的区域，并非只指圆周；实际道路行程可能更长。这是几何义在空间范围上的常见应用，见 [PLANMalaysia 规划文件](https://myplan.planmalaysia.gov.my/admin/uploads_publication/pdf_20240612103858_5.pdf)。

senses.zh_definition: 桡骨：前臂两根长骨之一，人体标准解剖姿势下位于拇指侧。
senses.en_definition: The forearm bone on the thumb side, lying alongside the ulna.
senses.ms_definition: Tulang lengan bawah yang terletak di sebelah ibu jari dan bersebelahan dengan ulna.
senses.nuances: 医学与解剖学术语，常写作 tulang radius；此义不是距离单位。DBP 医学术语库明确收录 radius 与 ulna 并列的前臂骨义，见 [DBP 术语资料](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=radius)。

etymology.historical_story: Radius ultimately comes from Latin, where it meant a staff, spoke, or ray. A wheel spoke offers a memorable image of a line reaching from centre to rim. Kamus Dewan labels the Malay borrowing IB, indicating an Indonesian–Dutch connection. Its anatomical use names a forearm bone. See [Oxford](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/us/definition/english/radius) and [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=radius).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 想象车轮的一根辐条：从中心伸到轮缘，就是 radius；两根对接才是直径。

morphology.pattern_note: 须区分同形异音词：réda 的 e 为 /e/，表示甘愿接受或认可；表示减弱、平息时 e 为 /ə/。两者均可构成 meredakan 和 keredaan，须按语境辨义。

word_family.gloss: 使平息、减弱；另可指甘愿准许
甘愿、认可；另指平静或减弱状态

senses.zh_definition: 真诚而甘愿地接受某种安排、遭遇、命运或他人的不足。
senses.en_definition: To accept a situation, outcome, or another person's shortcomings sincerely and willingly.
senses.ms_definition: Menerima ketentuan atau keadaan dengan hati yang ikhlas dan rela.
senses.nuances: 读 /re.da/。强调内心甘愿，常见于接受命运的语境，也可用于非宗教情境；不等于赞同造成伤害的行为。现代词类及释义见：[DBP：reda](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=takdir)。

senses.zh_definition: 宗教语境中，真主对一个人的善行所给予的认可与悦纳。
senses.en_definition: Divine approval or acceptance of a person's good deeds.
senses.ms_definition: Penerimaan dan perkenan Allah terhadap amalan baik seseorang.
senses.nuances: 读 /re.da/，主要见于 reda Allah 等宗教表达；不宜机械套用于一般行政批准。此名词义收于：[DBP《Kamus Dewan Perdana》释义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=takdir)。

senses.zh_definition: 雨、风暴等强度减弱，逐渐趋于停止。
senses.en_definition: Of rain, wind, or a storm, to abate or approach an end.
senses.ms_definition: Menjadi semakin lemah atau hampir berhenti, khususnya hujan dan angin ribut.
senses.nuances: 读 /rə.da/。表示势头减弱，不保证已经完全停止；hujan sudah reda 仍可能有小雨。义项依据：[DBP：reda](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=reda)。

senses.zh_definition: 愤怒、哭泣、紧张、喧闹或病情等逐渐减轻、平复。
senses.en_definition: Of anger, distress, tension, noise, or illness, to subside or become less intense.
senses.ms_definition: Berkurang kekuatannya atau kembali tenang, seperti kemarahan, tangisan, ketegangan dan penyakit.
senses.nuances: 读 /rə.da/。主语通常是情绪、症状或局势；表达“使其平息”时用 meredakan。与义项1的甘愿接受须分开理解。

senses.zh_definition: 原本持续出现的事物在数量或频次上明显减少，趋于稀少或消失。
senses.en_definition: To dwindle in number or frequency, approaching disappearance.
senses.ms_definition: Menjadi semakin sedikit atau jarang sehingga hampir tiada.
senses.nuances: 读 /rə.da/，是“减弱”向数量和频次的延伸，用法较具描写性。现代说明文常改用 semakin berkurang 或 semakin lengang。

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 宗教意义应尊重交谈者的信仰背景，避免把接受命运说成必须容忍伤害。马来西亚规范拼写为 reda；天气及情绪平息义可用于一般日常交流。

etymology.historical_story: The acceptance word réda is an Arabic loan associated with willingness and approval. Malay spelling standardisation replaced the older redha with reda, following the treatment of dh in several Arabic loans. The weather word has the same spelling but a different first vowel; its meaning should not be assigned the acceptance word's Arabic history. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=ejaan+rumi+baharu)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先听 e，再看主语：réda /e/ 配“人甘愿接受”；rəda /ə/ 配“雨势、怒气减弱”。把放松的 /ə/ 联想成势头慢慢松下来。

morphology.pattern_note: 这里采用英语读音，不按马来语 c = /tʃ/ 拼读。没有据此建立马来语派生词族；下列词族成员均属英语。

senses.zh_definition: 英语词：以速度决胜的比赛；也可引申为争取某个目标的竞争。
senses.en_definition: A contest of speed, or a competition to achieve a particular goal.
senses.ms_definition: Perkataan bahasa Inggeris yang bermaksud perlumbaan atau, mengikut konteks, persaingan untuk mencapai sesuatu.
senses.nuances: race 在这里属于英语，不应标成已核实的正式马来语词头；status 因此标为 foreign。以下搭配给出标准马来语对应表达。依据 [DBP 英马词典所列 race](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=berlumba)。

senses.zh_definition: 英语词：按血统或被认为共有的身体特征划分的人群类别；马来西亚日常语境中也常对应族群。
senses.en_definition: A social category of people associated with ancestry or perceived shared physical characteristics.
senses.ms_definition: Perkataan bahasa Inggeris yang merujuk kepada pengelasan manusia berdasarkan keturunan atau ciri fizikal yang dianggap dikongsi bersama; padanannya termasuk ras atau kaum mengikut konteks.
senses.nuances: race、ethnicity 与 nationality 的概念不能一概互换；翻译时须判断是在谈种族分类、族群还是国籍。英马对应参见 [Cambridge 英马词典：race](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/dictionary/english-malaysian/race)。

senses.zh_definition: 英语词：参加竞速比赛；与某人比速度；使车辆或动物参赛。
senses.en_definition: To compete in a speed contest, compete against someone, or enter something in such a contest.
senses.ms_definition: Perkataan bahasa Inggeris yang bermaksud berlumba, berlumba dengan seseorang atau memperlumbakan sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 口语混用可听到 nak race，但标准马来语通常使用 hendak berlumba。及物用法须依对象选择译法。依据 [DBP 英马词典：race](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=berlumba)。

senses.zh_definition: 英语词：疾行或急送；也指心脏、思绪或发动机快速运转。
senses.en_definition: To move or operate rapidly, or to transport someone or something at speed.
senses.ms_definition: Perkataan bahasa Inggeris yang bermaksud bergegas, bergerak dengan sangat laju atau membawa dengan segera; bagi jantung, berdebar-debar.
senses.nuances: 不一定涉及比赛。race to the office 可译 bergegas ke pejabat，a racing heart 则须按身体反应翻译。依据 [DBP 英马词典：race](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=berlumba)。

etymology.historical_story: English race brings together historically separate words. The competition word traces through Middle English to Old Norse rás, associated with running. The ancestry word came through French from Italian razza. Their identical spelling can mislead translators: a sports report may require perlumbaan, while a discussion of social identity requires a different Malay equivalent. [Merriam-Webster: race](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/race)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先看场景再翻译：跑道上的 race → perlumbaan；族群讨论中的 race → kaum／ras。读 /reɪs/，不要按马来语 c 的读法读。

etymology.historical_story: RM abbreviates Ringgit Malaysia. The name ringgit recalls the serrated edges of Spanish silver coins once widely used in trade. Malaysia's official account dates the adoption of ringgit as the currency's proper name to 1975 and the replacement of the dollar symbol with RM to 1993, linking today's price labels with an older coin tradition. senses.nuances: DBP 标注 Jw（爪哇语）及 sl（古典文学用语）。现代马来西亚日常交流通常用 ayah、bapa 或 abah。此义没有可确认为现代高频的搭配；下列短语仅示范古典语境中的组合。不要把单独的 rama 释为蝴蝶，也不要与专名 Rama 混同。[DBP 释义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=rama)。

etymology.historical_story: Kamus Dewan menandai rama sebagai kata Jawa yang digunakan dalam sastera lama dengan makna ayah atau bapa. Catatan ini menunjukkan lapisan hubungan bahasa antara masyarakat Melayu dengan Jawa yang masih tersimpan dalam perbendaharaan sastera. Pembaca moden lebih mudah mengenali bentuk rama-rama, tetapi nama serangga itu perlu dibezakan daripada rama sebagai istilah kekeluargaan. [Catatan Kamus Dewan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=rama).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ra-ma 放进古典故事的父子对话里记：单个 rama 是“父亲”；看到 rama-rama，再想到昆虫。

etymology.historical_story: Rintihan belongs to the Malay family built around rintih, with the noun-forming suffix -an. Its dictionary senses connect an audible groan with a spoken lament and inward sorrow. That connection makes the word useful across descriptions of bodily pain, accounts of social hardship and literary expressions of grief. No more distant origin is established by the supplied evidence.

etymology.historical_story: English relax came through French from Latin relaxāre, meaning to loosen. The physical idea of releasing tension developed into familiar meanings involving rest and calm. Malay has the adapted spelling relaks, while relax can appear when speakers switch into English. The spelling difference therefore signals language choice rather than a separate Malay affix pattern. [American Heritage: relax](https://ahdictionary.com/word/search.html?q=relax)

etymology.historical_story: Malay uses the tree as a model for relationships: a trunk supports branches, and branches carry smaller twigs. Ranting names those smaller growths. Its organizational and figurative dictionary senses follow the same image, describing subordinate units and secondary matters. This semantic connection explains the meanings without requiring a speculative story about the word's earliest origin.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ran-ting 连到一幅树形图：主干之后是大枝，大枝末端才是 ranting；组织的小支部、讨论的小枝节也挂在末端。

etymology.historical_story: Rekrut has a documented place in Malaysia's policing history. The Royal Malaysia Police records a recruitment intake in January 1946, with 700 newcomers trained in Kuala Lumpur and Johor Bahru. This gives the word a concrete institutional setting: a newcomer entering disciplined service. Modern dictionary usage also includes new members of organizations. See [PDRM's historical timeline](https://rmp2u.rmp.gov.my/content/garis-masa-sejarah) and [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=rekrut).

etymology.historical_story: Kamus Dewan labels the animal name rubah as an Arabic loan and records its Jawi spelling as روبه. The dictionary also preserves a separate, archaic change-related entry under the same spelling. This pairing illustrates how one written form can carry unrelated lexical histories: the animal name should not be interpreted as a derivative of ubah. [DBP: rubah](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=rubah)

etymology.historical_story: In administrative English, reg. can abbreviate registration. Such labels can appear within otherwise Malay business communication. A DBP signage consultation explicitly recommends replacing “Reg. No.” with “No. Pendaftaran”. This documents a language-use boundary rather than an established Malay borrowing. etymology.historical_story: Rencana is traced to Sanskrit racana, associated with arranging and composing. Its Malay meanings connect written composition with the arrangement of future action: an article and a plan both put material into order. Malaysian newspaper usage makes the article sense especially useful today. Adding -nya identifies whose composition it is, or points back to one already mentioned. [Etymology](https://kaikki.org/dictionary/Malay/meaning/r/re/rencana.html)

etymology.historical_story: Rabbi comes from Arabic rabbī, meaning 'my Lord': rabb supplies the idea of lordship, and the attached ending expresses 'my'. Quranic prayer provides a familiar setting for this form, including requests for knowledge. Malay preserves it as a devotional borrowing, so its personal sense remains important: the speaker is addressing God as their own Lord. [Quranic Arabic Corpus](https://corpus.quran.com/qurandictionary.jsp?root=rbb)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: rab-bi：把来源中的 rabb 记作“主”，末尾 ī 记作“我的”，合起来就是“我的主”。

morphology.pattern_note: 这是英语专名，不按马来语词缀拆分；规范书写通常为 Riddick。IPA 表示英语读音，尚无已核实的马来语专用读音或官方爪夷拼写。

etymology.historical_story: Riddick belongs here to the world of names rather than Malay word formation. Universal identifies the character with a film series that began with Pitch Black in 2000 and later included Riddick. This explains the name's appearance in entertainment writing; it does not establish a Malay lexical origin. [Studio account](https://corporate.comcast.com/news-information/news-feed/behind-the-scenes-of-universal-pictures-riddick)

morphology.pattern_note: 日语借词，整词作为独立词素记忆，不能拆成马来语词缀。所列 IPA 为马来语适应读音，e 为元音 /e/；输入包的 /ɹɑːmən/ 是英语读音候选。音节为补充分析；爪夷文因无核实依据保留 null。

etymology.historical_story: Malay uses the Japanese food name ramen as a whole borrowed word. The dish developed through the meeting of Chinese noodle traditions and Japanese cooking. Its name is commonly linked to Chinese lamian, although the precise naming history is debated. Remembering the cultural exchange is more reliable than assuming every bowl contains hand-pulled noodles. [Shin-Yokohama Ramen Museum: The Roots of Ramen](https://artsandculture.google.com/story/CAVxS5QL1jNFKw?hl=en)

morphology.pattern_note: -nya 是附着代词，此处表示第三人称或回指对象的所属关系，不是派生新词的词缀；/ɲ/ 是单个鼻音。headword.jawi 保留输入的词根写法 روح；包含 -nya 的完整形式为 روحڽ。

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 可用于宗教讨论、悼念及艺术评论。评论作品“失去灵魂”属于主观评价；面对丧亲者时避免拿亡者的灵魂开玩笑。

etymology.historical_story: Roh is borrowed from Arabic rūḥ, meaning spirit or soul. In Malay, the word belongs both to religious discussion and to figurative descriptions of an essential spirit. Adding the Malay enclitic -nya makes that soul or essence belong to someone or something already identified, without marking the referent's gender.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 roh＝灵魂，再接 -nya＝他／她／它的：rohnya 就是“其灵魂”，也可比喻“其精髓”。

morphology.pattern_note: 本词不含可拆分词缀；按词包保留 syllables 为 riang，给定 IPA 则呈 ri.aŋ。meriangkan 中 meN- 在 r 前呈 me-，r 保留。

senses.zh_definition: 欢快的；心情喜悦、轻松而充满快乐的。
senses.en_definition: Cheerful, merry, or joyful.
senses.ms_definition: Sangat gembira, girang hati atau suka hati.
senses.nuances: 这是现代标准马来语的主要义项，常描写心情、神态、笑声和欢乐活动。dengan riang 中本词作方式描写，但基本词类仍是形容词。以下同形义项分别列出，不应互相混译；参见 [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=150348&keyword=riang)。

senses.zh_definition: 身体微感发热或不适的；同 meriang，为较少见的同形义项。
senses.en_definition: Feeling feverish or unwell; an uncommon equivalent of meriang.
senses.ms_definition: Meriang; berasa agak demam atau tidak sedap badan.
senses.nuances: 不可套用“快乐”的常用义。现代一般交流使用 meriang 更清楚；riang semangat 是词典记录的特殊组合，表示头晕、发怵或心神不稳。下列为受限搭配，不属于现代常用义的高频搭配。

senses.zh_definition: 精力、力气或行动能力；吉打及槟城方言用法。
senses.en_definition: Energy, strength, or capacity for exertion, in Kedah and Penang dialect usage.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam dialek Kedah dan Pulau Pinang, tenaga, kuasa atau daya.
senses.nuances: 带有明确地域限制，不是标准语中表示“精力”的通用替代词。标准表达通常使用 tenaga 或 daya。下列为方言语境中的搭配。

senses.zh_definition: 蝉；雄虫具有发声器官、能发出响亮鸣声的一类昆虫。
senses.en_definition: A cicada, an insect whose males produce loud calls.
senses.ms_definition: Serangga berkepala lebar dan bersayap lut sinar, yang jantannya mempunyai organ penghasil bunyi nyaring.
senses.nuances: 这是动物名称的同形义项，《Kamus Pelajar》亦列 riang-riang 和 reriang。表示巨蜥的 riang-riang 属另一名称，不能直接当作单写 riang 的常用义。下列搭配中的 riang 均指昆虫。

etymology.historical_story: In Malay expressions such as riang ria, the word evokes shared merriment rather than a complicated origin story. Its productive family extends from a joyful state to keriangan, the feeling of joy, and periang, someone habitually cheerful. Dictionary homonyms also name illness, regional strength, and cicadas; those meanings should remain separate.

senses.zh_definition: 在花钱、饮食、享受或行为上过分铺张、奢侈或挥霍的。

etymology.historical_story: DBP labels royal as IB, identifying an Indonesian Dutch borrowing. The entry centres on excess in spending, eating, drinking, and behaviour. Its Malay derivatives extend this idea into lavish pleasure seeking and extravagance. This borrowing history helps explain why a form familiar from English can carry a different everyday meaning in Malay. [DBP terminology](https://jendeladbp.my/app/uploads/woocommerce_uploads/2025/08/PB-9-2025-TERBIT-7yzukl.pdf).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 royal 想成“花钱摆出王室排场”：排场过头就是铺张挥霍。只是记忆画面；本词在这里不表示“王室的”。

morphology.pattern_note: 词根保持完整。meN-、peN- 接词首 r 时分别形成 merakit、perakit，不额外插入鼻音；ber- + rakit → berakit，接合处不写双 r。

senses.zh_definition: 筏；把竹、木或其他具有浮力的材料连接成的水上平台，用于载人、运货或其他水上用途。
senses.en_definition: A floating platform made from joined buoyant materials, used for transport or other purposes on water.
senses.ms_definition: Pelantar terapung daripada buluh, kayu atau bahan apung lain yang dirangkaikan untuk membawa orang, barang atau kegunaan lain di air.
senses.nuances: 传统形态多为竹筏或木筏；现代复合词也可指充气式救生筏。rakit 与有船体的 perahu 不完全相同。rumah rakit 指建在浮筏上的房屋。另有带 Jw 标记的 serakit，意为一对，不能据此把普通 rakit 解释成数量词。[DBP 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=250808&keyword=rakit)。

senses.zh_definition: 鸟名构词成分，见 burung rakit，指黑红阔嘴鸟。
senses.en_definition: A bird-name element in burung rakit, denoting the black-and-red broadbill.
senses.ms_definition: Unsur nama burung dalam sebutan burung rakit, yang juga dikenal sebagai burung hujan-hujan.
senses.nuances: 这是词典另列的同形词，通常见于完整鸟名 burung rakit；不是常用筏义的延伸。以下搭配属于鸟类描述用语，使用频率低于筏义搭配。DBP 所列旧学名为 Cymbirhyncus macrorhyncos malaccensis。[DBP 同形词释义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=250808&keyword=rakit)。

etymology.historical_story: Rakit carries a cultural image beyond river transport. A Malay proverb pairs the effort of rafting upstream with later ease, expressing the lesson that hardship comes before comfort. DBP also records merakit with figurative meanings involving orderly arrangement. The physical picture of materials joined into a raft therefore offers a useful bridge between transport and organization. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=250808&keyword=rakit).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把竹子一根根绑齐，形成 rakit；berakit 是乘筏走，merakit 是把材料组织起来。

senses.ms_definition: Raghu ialah nama khas orang yang ditemukan dalam penggunaan sebenar; rujukan token dalam paket ini belum dapat dipastikan.

etymology.historical_story: Raghu is documented as a personal name on an Indian Institute of Science personnel page. Such names can appear unchanged inside Malay sentences, where their role is to identify people. morphology.pattern_note: -lah 与前词连写，通常不改变 rasa 的音段；它是 partikel penegas，不是派生后缀。affix_type 因此记为 none。输入 jawi 为词根 rasa 的写法，不能视为完整 rasalah 的写法。

senses.zh_definition: 尝尝；品尝一下。由 rasa 加 -lah 构成，常用于邀请或劝请对方品尝。
senses.en_definition: Taste or try something, especially as an invitation or softened instruction.
senses.ms_definition: Mengecap makanan atau minuman dengan lidah; dalam ayat perintah, mengajak atau menyuruh seseorang mencubanya.
senses.nuances: 这是 rasa 在祈使结构中附加 -lah 的用法，不是独立产生的新词义。释义为依据输入词根义编写的说明，并非 DBP 对 rasalah 的逐字释义。DBP 说明 -lah 可缓和命令，见 [partikel](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=partikel)。搭配为自然示例，未作频率排序。

senses.zh_definition: 感受一下；亲自体会。常带邀请、强调或挑战语气，具体态度取决于上下文。
senses.en_definition: Feel or experience something, with an inviting, emphatic or challenging force.
senses.ms_definition: Mengalami atau menghayati sesuatu sendiri, dengan penegasan melalui partikel -lah.
senses.nuances: 体验义承接 rasa 的感受意义；-lah 调节语气。与痛苦、后果等词连用时，可能带责备意味。这是组合用法的编辑释义，不是独立官方词条释义。

senses.zh_definition: 觉得；认为；估计。在 saya rasalah 等表达中提出个人判断，语气随语境变化。
senses.en_definition: Think or suppose, presenting a personal judgment with discourse emphasis.
senses.ms_definition: Berpendapat atau mengagak sesuatu, dengan penegasan melalui partikel -lah.
senses.nuances: 这里不是“品尝”。DBP 的语文咨询明确认可 Aku rasalah 一类连写形式，见 [rasa lah](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=rasa+lah)。适合会话中的个人看法；正式分析通常用 pada pendapat saya 等更明确的表达。official 指其规范构形有依据，不表示它是独立收录的词头。

etymology.historical_story: Rasalah illustrates how Malay builds conversational meaning by attaching a particle to an existing word. Rasa supplies the lexical meaning, while -lah adds emphasis or softens an instruction. DBP treats -lah as a particle rather than a derivational affix. The written form therefore preserves a grammatical combination, not a newly derived root. See [DBP's explanation](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=partikel).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: rasa“尝、感受、觉得”＋ lah“语气按钮”：端着食物说 rasalah，就是“尝尝吧”。

etymology.historical_story: Roberto belongs to the international family of names related to Robert. Its deeper Germanic elements are associated with fame and brightness, while Italian, Spanish and Portuguese use the form Roberto. In Malay, the name identifies a person as a whole; its historical elements do not function as productive Malay roots or affixes. [Roberto](https://www.behindthename.com/name/roberto)；[Robert](https://www.behindthename.com/name/robert)

senses.zh_definition: 通过通信、网络或其他技术在异地进行操作、访问、工作或学习的；远程的。
senses.en_definition: Operating, accessed, or carried out at a distance, often through technology.
senses.ms_definition: Dikendalikan, dicapai atau dilaksanakan dari lokasi lain, lazimnya melalui teknologi komunikasi.
senses.nuances: 英语技术和工作用语；马来语采用 jarak jauh、capaian jauh 等相应表达。remote work 不必然表示在家工作，也可能从其他异地地点开展。[Cambridge：remote](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/remote)

senses.zh_definition: 发生的可能性很小的；极不可能的。

senses.zh_definition: 与某事缺乏紧密联系的；相去甚远的。

senses.ms_definition: Tidak mempunyai hubungan yang rapat dengan sesuatu; jauh berbeza atau kurang berkaitan.
senses.nuances: 英语中常用 remote from 表示关联或经验上的距离；翻译时应表达具体关系。[Collins：remote](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/remote)

senses.zh_definition: 待人冷淡、保持情感距离的；疏离的。

senses.ms_definition: Bersikap dingin dan kurang menunjukkan kemesraan atau penglibatan terhadap orang lain.
senses.nuances: 英语人物评价义，可能带批评意味；不能据此推断当事人无礼或缺乏同情心。[Collins：remote](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/remote)

etymology.historical_story: English remote comes from Latin remotus, the past participle of removere, meaning to move away. Its central image of distance extends naturally from isolated places to distant times, slight possibilities and emotional separation. In modern technology, remote control makes that distance practical: a person can operate equipment without standing beside it.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 remote 和遥控器连起来：人离设备有距离，仍能控制；再由距离联想到偏远、久远和疏离。

word_family.gloss: 多条丝带；完整重叠形式

senses.zh_definition: 丝带、缎带或彩带；用于捆扎、包装或装饰的细长薄条。
senses.en_definition: A long, narrow strip of fabric, paper, or similar material used for tying or decoration.
senses.ms_definition: Jalur panjang dan nipis daripada kain, kertas atau bahan seumpamanya untuk mengikat bungkusan atau menghias sesuatu; pita.
senses.nuances: 不限定为丝绸材质；也可指系成蝴蝶结的装饰带。pita 的适用范围更广，不能把所有胶带或录音带都称为 reben。释义转述自 [DBP：reben](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=reben)。

senses.zh_definition: 打字机色带；浸有专用油墨、供字模击打转印文字的细长带。
senses.en_definition: An inked ribbon used in a typewriter to transfer characters onto paper.
senses.ms_definition: Jalur kain panjang dan nipis yang mengandungi dakwat khas untuk digunakan dalam mesin taip.
senses.nuances: 这是办公设备用义，与装饰丝带不同。相关色带式打印设备也使用 reben dakwat 一类说法；喷墨打印机的墨盒不能因此称为 reben。打字机义见 [DBP：reben](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=reben)。

etymology.historical_story: Reben brings together two material worlds: colourful strips used for decoration and ink-bearing strips used in typewriters. DBP records both meanings, showing how one familiar shape supports different functions. Its resemblance to English ribbon suggests a borrowing connection, but the sources checked here do not establish the precise route or date of entry into Malay. [Source: DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=reben).

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 用于称呼或指认人物。不要从这个英语名字推断对方的宗教、族群或国籍；也不要擅自把名字缩成 Rod。

etymology.historical_story: Rodney travelled from an English place name into a surname and subsequently a given name. The Dictionary of American Family Names tentatively connects the place name with the Old English personal name Hrōda and an element meaning island or raised ground in marshland. It places the probable emergence of the given name in the eighteenth century. [Source](https://www.ancestry.com/last-name-meaning/rodney)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 读作近似“罗德尼”，脑中放一张写着 Rodney 的姓名牌：记住这是人的名字，不是可逐段翻译的马来词。

morphology.pattern_note: -ku 是 aku 的附着形式，表示第一人称领属，须与前面的名词连写；此处按字段归入 suffix，但属于附着代词，不是派生后缀。词根无音变。输入中的 راکن 仅拼写词根 rakan，完整形式需加 کو。

word_family.gloss: 你的朋友或伙伴；附着代词形式
他或她的朋友、伙伴；附着代词形式

senses.zh_definition: 我的朋友或同伴；与我有交往、一起学习、玩耍或从事其他活动的人。
senses.en_definition: My friend or companion.
senses.ms_definition: Sahabat atau teman aku; bentuk rakan yang digabungkan dengan kata ganti nama singkat -ku.
senses.nuances: 这是根据词根释义及领属结构合成的释义，并非独立词条的逐字引文。-ku 表示“我的”，不表示复数；明确表示“我的朋友们”可用 rakan-rakanku。日常聊天通常更常说 kawan aku 或 rakan saya。连写规则见 [DBP：ku](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=ku)。

senses.zh_definition: 我的合作伙伴或同事；与我在同一工作、组织或合作关系中共事的人。
senses.en_definition: My colleague, associate, or partner in a shared undertaking.
senses.ms_definition: Orang yang bekerjasama dengan aku dalam pekerjaan, perkongsian atau sesuatu kegiatan.
senses.nuances: 具体关系由 niaga、sejawat 等成分或上下文确定；并不默认指恋爱伴侣。正式职场陈述通常以 rakan saya 更得体。

etymology.historical_story: Rakanku is a transparent grammatical combination rather than a separate historical root. Malay attaches the shortened pronoun ku to a preceding noun to express possession or association. This compact pattern also appears in rumahku and bukuku. In rakanku, the relationship becomes personal: a companion is identified as mine. See [DBP spelling guidance](https://eseminar.dbp.gov.my/dokumen/ejaan.pdf).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: rakan 是朋友，尾巴 -ku 是“我的”：rakan + ku，朋友跟着我。

morphology.pattern_note: 作为完整专名记忆，不按马来语词缀拆分。规范人名首字母写作 Rudy；此处 IPA 表示可用的马来语读法，个人实际读音以本人为准。

senses.zh_definition: 鲁迪；人名 Rudy 的音译，通常用作男性名字。在马来语文本中属于专有名词，不是已核实的普通马来语词条。
senses.en_definition: Rudy, a personal name, commonly masculine; a proper noun rather than a verified Malay common word.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas orang yang dieja Rudy; lazimnya digunakan sebagai nama lelaki. Takrif deskriptif ini bukan petikan definisi rasmi DBP.
senses.nuances: 输入不足以确定具体人物、族群或姓名来源，因此 status 标为 unverified，不能据此标注为已获 DBP 确认的官方普通词。以下词组展示姓名用法，不代表固定高频搭配。英语姓名词典将 Rudy 列为 Rudolf 的昵称形式，但不能据此推断每位同名者的命名来源。参见 [Behind the Name：Rudy](https://www.behindthename.com/name/rudy)。

etymology.historical_story: In English naming tradition, Rudy is a familiar form of Rudolf. The longer name contains Germanic elements associated with fame and the wolf. That history belongs to one documented naming tradition, however; a person called Rudy in Malaysia may have a different family explanation, so the spelling alone cannot establish individual ancestry. See [Rudy](https://www.behindthename.com/name/rudy) and [Rudolf](https://www.behindthename.com/name/rudolf).

senses.zh_definition: 日本佛教仪式中用于伴随诵经的钵形铜制打击体鸣乐器，以木槌敲击侧面发声。
senses.en_definition: A Japanese bowl-shaped copper-alloy idiophone struck on the side with a wooden beater to accompany Buddhist chanting.
senses.ms_definition: Alat muzik tradisional yang diklasifikasikan sebagai idiofon yang dipukul.
senses.nuances: 马来语音乐专门术语，指日本佛教所用的钵形敲击乐器；并非日常泛指铃铛的词。马来语释义节录自官方术语条目：[DBP PRPM：rin](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=RIN+)。以下搭配为说明性组合，未作语料频率排序。

etymology.historical_story: The instrument connects Malay musical terminology with Japanese Buddhist craftsmanship. In Takaoka, metalworkers have passed down the skills used to shape and tune bowl bells called rin or orin. A workshop established in 1909 describes making these bells by hand from brass. A Japanese origin for the Malay term is therefore plausible, although its precise borrowing history remains unverified. [JETRO workshop profile](https://www.jetro.go.jp/ext_images/en/eccj/takuminext/pdf/TAKUMINEXT2020_Brochure.pdf)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rin 联想成敲击金属钵后清亮的一声：rin——钵铃响了。只是声音联想，不是词源解释。

morphology.pattern_note: 独立词根，词尾 ai 为双元音 /ai̯/。merumpai 由 meN- + rumpai 构成，词根以 r 开头时前缀表现为 me-，保留词根 r。

word_family.gloss: 海藻；由 rumpai 与 laut 组成的复合词

senses.zh_definition: 杂草；生长在已开垦或栽培区域内、不为该处种植目的所需的草及其他小型植物。
senses.en_definition: Weeds; grasses and other small plants growing unwanted in cultivated ground.
senses.ms_definition: Rumput dan tumbuh-tumbuhan kecil lain yang tidak berguna di kawasan yang telah diusahakan.
senses.nuances: 强调植物在某个栽培环境中“不受需要”，并非断言该植物在任何环境下都没有用途。rumput 通常指草，rumpai 的范围还包括其他不受需要的植物。释义依据 [PRPM：rumpai](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=172780&keyword=rumpai)。

senses.zh_definition: 用于复合词 rumpai laut，指海藻，即生长于海中或海岸浸水岩石上的绿藻、褐藻或红藻等。
senses.en_definition: In the compound rumpai laut: seaweed; marine algae growing in the sea or on submerged coastal rocks.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam rangkai kata rumpai laut, tumbuhan berwarna hijau, perang atau merah gelap yang hidup di dalam laut atau di atas batuan yang terendam di pinggir laut.
senses.nuances: 此义属于完整复合词 rumpai laut；初学者不宜把单独的 rumpai 一律译作“海藻”。这里的 rumpai laut 不带“必须清除的杂草”之意。复合词释义见 [PRPM：rumpai](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=172780&keyword=rumpai)。

etymology.historical_story: The packet does not establish rumpai's deeper historical origin. Its cultural interest lies in the contrast between unwanted plants in cultivated ground and the established compound rumpai laut, meaning seaweed. Malaysia records farmed seaweed as an agricultural product. The compound therefore names a useful crop without requiring the negative judgement associated with weeds in a garden.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rum-pai 联想成“菜畦旁排排冒出的杂草”；再记 laut 是“海”，rumpai laut → 海藻。声音联想仅作助记。
etymology.source_note: 海藻养殖与生产的现实用法见 [马来西亚官方数据：各州每月海藻产量](https://data.gov.my/ms-MY/data-catalogue/seaweed_production)。

etymology.historical_story: Recon is a shortened form of English reconditioned in Malaysian automotive trade. Its local meaning developed around imported used vehicles, rather than simply anything repaired. Malaysian consumer and industry sources distinguish these imports from locally used cars. The term therefore carries a market category as well as a suggestion of preparation for resale. [FOMCA](https://www.fomca.org.my/v1/index.php/fomca-di-pentas-media/consumer-digest/909-pros-and-cons-of-used-vs-new-cars-plus-full-buying-guide-for-second-hand-and-recon-cars-in-malaysia), [industry terminology](https://mycc.gov.my/sites/default/files/17.6.2021%20Draft%20Final%20Report.pdf)

etymology.historical_story: Robertson belongs to the patronymic tradition: its historical construction identifies someone as a son of Robert. Historical surname dictionaries document this interpretation and its Scottish connections. As an inherited surname, however, it identifies a family rather than stating the current bearer's father's name. Its presence in Malay text remains a proper-name occurrence, not evidence of Malay derivation. [Source](https://forebears.io/surnames/robertson).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: Robert + son 联想“Robert 的儿子”，记住姓氏来源；日常称呼仍把 Robertson 当作完整姓氏。

etymology.historical_story: English rusty combines rust with the adjective-forming suffix -y. Its physical and figurative meanings offer a memorable connection: metal can become rusty, while a once-familiar skill can become rusty through disuse. The figurative sense describes lost fluency rather than permanent inability, making it useful when talking about returning to a language or activity. [Source](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/rusty)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: rust 是锈，rusty 是生锈；把久不用的技能想成一把生锈的钥匙，练一练就转得顺。

etymology.historical_story: Rasengan belongs to the fictional vocabulary of Naruto. The official series website describes Minato creating the technique and Kushina naming it; Naruto later inherits and develops it. Its association with a spinning sphere makes the name a memorable link between visual action and fictional terminology, rather than evidence of Malay affixation. [Source: NARUTO Official Site](https://naruto-official.com/en/news/01_1521).

etymology.historical_story: Rem was borrowed from Dutch rem, meaning brake. Its mechanical meaning also provides a vivid metaphor: a brake slows a vehicle, while an obstacle slows social or personal progress. The borrowed noun participates in local word formation through mengerem, meaning to brake or restrain. Malaysian Malay generally uses brek, illustrating different borrowing histories within the wider Malay-speaking world. [Etymology reference](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/rem#Indonesian).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 念 rem 时，收尾的 m 让双唇合拢，像把移动中的东西稳稳停住：rem＝刹车，也可比喻阻力。

etymology.historical_story: Malay rasis is recorded as a borrowing from English racist. Its compact spelling fits Malay pronunciation, while DBP connects its meaning with rasialis. The related noun rasisme names the ideology or phenomenon. Together, these words allow speakers to distinguish a prejudiced statement, a person holding racist beliefs, and the broader problem of racial discrimination. [Wiktionary: Malay rasis](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/rasis), [DBP: rasisme](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=rasisme)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ra.sis 与英语 racist 联想：看到 kenyataan rasis，就想到“带种族歧视的言论”；rasisme 则是“种族主义或种族歧视现象”。

etymology.historical_story: DBP identifies rahib as an Arabic borrowing, illustrating how Malay absorbed vocabulary for religious lives beyond its own majority tradition. Kamus Dewan associates it specifically with Christian monasteries, while Kamus Pelajar also includes Buddhist religious practice. That difference makes context important: the same Malay label can have a narrower or broader religious reference. [Source: PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=rahib).

etymology.historical_story: Ronaldo is a Portuguese adaptation of Ronald, according to the onomastic dictionary discussed by Ciberdúvidas. This is a history of a personal name travelling between languages, rather than a Malay word acquiring a new lexical meaning. For learners, the useful distinction is between the inherited name and the particular person it identifies in a sentence. [Ciberdúvidas: Ronaldo](https://ciberduvidas.iscte-iul.pt/consultorio/perguntas/ronaldo/14968)

etymology.historical_story: Malay proverbial language turns the ripening rice plant into a lesson about character: a grain-heavy stalk bends downward, suggesting that knowledge and achievement should bring humility. Resmi names the characteristic nature behind that comparison. This is a documented cultural association, rather than proof of the word's ultimate origin, which the supplied packet does not establish.

etymology.historical_story: Ramos connects family naming with the landscape. Spanish and Portuguese ramos means branches and continues Latin ramus. As a surname, it can identify origins in a place called Ramos or an association with wooded surroundings. These are historical naming explanations, however, and do not establish one shared ancestor or one precise origin for every bearer. Source: [Dictionary of American Family Names, via Ancestry](https://www.ancestry.com/last-name-meaning/ramos).

etymology.historical_story: Raphael berasal daripada nama Ibrani yang menggabungkan unsur penyembuhan dengan unsur El, iaitu Tuhan. Maknanya lazim dihuraikan sebagai Tuhan menyembuhkan atau Tuhan telah menyembuhkan. Nama ini tersebar melalui tradisi keagamaan dan pelbagai bahasa. Apabila digunakan dalam bahasa Melayu, nama tersebut kekal sebagai nama khas, tanpa menerima pemecahan morfologi Melayu. [Rujukan etimologi: Raphael](https://www.etymonline.com/word/Raphael).

word_family.gloss: 风险；此输入形式对应的标准拼写

senses.zh_definition: 风险；发生危险、损失或其他不利情况的可能性。标准拼写为 risiko。
senses.en_definition: Nonstandard spelling of risiko: the possibility of danger, loss, or harm.
senses.ms_definition: Ejaan tidak baku bagi risiko, iaitu kemungkinan mengalami bahaya atau kerugian.
senses.nuances: 以下搭配采用规范拼写，不把 resiko 示范为标准马来语。DBP 收录 risiko；印度尼西亚官方词典亦明确将 resiko 标为非标准形式。参见：[DBP risiko](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=risiko) 与 [KBBI risiko](https://kbbi.kemendikdasmen.go.id/entri/risiko)。

senses.zh_definition: 某项行动可能带来的不良后果或损失；标准形式 risiko 的引申义。
senses.en_definition: An adverse consequence or undesirable outcome of an action, under the standard form risiko.
senses.ms_definition: Akibat atau hasil yang tidak menyenangkan daripada sesuatu tindakan; padah.
senses.nuances: 此义强调不利后果，而不只是发生概率；不代表后果必然已经发生。现代专业讨论中，宜按语境区分 risiko、kesan 和 akibat。

etymology.historical_story: Resiko should be understood as a nonstandard spelling of risiko, rather than a separately established Malay headword with its own origin story. DBP records risiko and labels its source language as English. Indonesian's official dictionary likewise identifies resiko as nonstandard. The practical lesson is to recognise the variant while producing the standard spelling. Sources: [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=risiko) and [KBBI](https://kbbi.kemendikdasmen.go.id/entri/risiko).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 想到英语 risk，保留开头 ri-：risk → risiko。记住两个 i，避免写成 resiko；这是拼写助记。

etymology.historical_story: English rise continues Old English rīsan, which described getting up or standing. Its modern meanings extend upward movement to prices, status and other scales. This history belongs to English; encountering rise in Malaysian material does not establish it as a Malay loanword. The surrounding sentence must distinguish an English quotation from a name or other use. [Etymonline: rise](https://www.etymonline.com/word/rise).

etymology.historical_story: The historical connection concerns standard raksasa, a Malay word linked to Sanskrit rākṣasa, a demonic being. In Malay, the familiar giant of stories also supplies an image for extraordinary size. That figurative bridge helps explain expressions about enormous companies and plans. It does not establish a separate origin or accepted status for raksaksa. [Sanskrit loanwords in Malay](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_loanwords_in_Malay_language).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 纠错记忆：ra-k-sa-sa，只有一个 k；看到 raksaksa，就删掉后面多出的 k，得到 raksasa。

senses.en_definition: A term used in naming the Rh blood group system; routine positive or negative status usually refers to the D antigen.
senses.ms_definition: Istilah dalam nama sistem kumpulan darah Rh; status Rh positif atau negatif lazimnya merujuk kepada kehadiran atau ketiadaan antigen D pada sel darah merah.
senses.nuances: 常用于 faktor Rhesus、faktor Rh 或 sistem Rhesus。Rh 是一个包含多种抗原的系统，不能把整个系统等同于单一 D 抗原。DBP 术语表收录 faktor resus 与 faktor Rh；此处综合释义并非逐字引文。[DBP 术语](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=Rh)。

etymology.historical_story: The blood-group name preserves a link with rhesus monkeys. Landsteiner and Wiener investigated reactions involving anti-rhesus sera in work published around 1940–1941, and the label Rh became established. The modern human Rh system is more complex than that historical label suggests. The shared name therefore records an experimental connection, rather than making human and monkey blood interchangeable. [Original research](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC2135190/).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 rhesus 的开头 Rh：看到血型里的加号或减号，就联想到 Rh 状态；看到 monyet rhesus，则想到恒河猴。

senses.ms_definition: Sebutan bagi unit mata wang Brunei atau Singapura dalam penggunaan bahasa Melayu tertentu.

senses.zh_definition: 历史上荷兰殖民时期印度尼西亚使用的一种银币或货币单位，价值为二点五盾。
senses.en_definition: A historical silver coin or monetary unit worth 2.5 rupiah in the Dutch East Indies.
senses.ms_definition: Mata wang atau wang daripada perak yang bernilai 2.5 rupiah dan digunakan pada zaman penjajahan Belanda di Indonesia.
senses.nuances: 输入所附 DBP 释义标记为 Id，即印度尼西亚用法。此处 rupiah 指历史货币语境，不能视为现代令吉与印尼盾的兑换比率。以下为历史说明性搭配。

etymology.historical_story: Ringgit preserves a link between money and the serrated edges of Spanish silver coins once widely used in the region. The same spelling also denotes serrations in Malay dictionaries. Malaysia officially adopted Ringgit as its currency name in 1975, carrying an older local monetary name into modern national usage. [马来西亚政府：Mata Wang](https://www.malaysia.gov.my/my/government/kenali-malaysia/mata-wang) [DBP：ringgit II](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=ringgit+II)

etymology.historical_story: Malay dictionaries treat resah as a base word and record a family describing both unease and its effects. Keresahan names the troubled state, while meresahkan describes causing it. This lexical family connects private feelings with disturbances affecting a wider community. The consulted dictionary evidence does not establish a specific donor language or a dated origin.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 re.sah 联想成“惹啥事了？”：一担心出了什么事，心里就 resah。此为联想，不是词源。

etymology.historical_story: Ramírez is a Spanish patronymic surname traditionally meaning 'son of Ramiro'. Such surnames preserve an ancestral naming relationship rather than identifying the current bearer's father. The accentless spelling Ramirez also occurs. This history concerns Spanish naming, not Malay affixation. The patronymic relationship is discussed in an [onomastic conference paper](https://www.gencat.cat/llengua/BTPL/ICOS2011/089.pdf).

etymology.historical_story: In traditional Malay houses, the rasuk carries the joists beneath the floor. A proverb contrasts noisy talk with the beam that actually bears the load, giving this building word a social lesson about responsibility. Dictionaries separately record rasuk in spirit-possession expressions. Their identical spelling does not prove that one meaning developed from the other.

etymology.historical_story: Refleks belongs to the international scientific vocabulary represented in English by reflex. Malay uses the spelling ks for the final consonant sequence. Its medical meaning is recorded in Kamus Dewan Perdana, while mathematics and historical linguistics use distinct technical senses. The shared spelling connects these terminologies, but it does not make their definitions interchangeable.

etymology.historical_story: Robotik belongs to the international vocabulary of robotics. Its word family reaches back to Czech robota, meaning compulsory labour, and robot, popularized through Karel Čapek’s play R.U.R. The literary image of artificial workers later became the vocabulary of laboratories and factories; Malay distinguishes robot, the machine, from robotik, the field. [Czech Embassy: the history of robot](https://mzv.gov.cz/tirana/en/about_the_czech_republic/x100_year_ago_robot_was_born.html); [DBP: robotik](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=robotik).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先认出 robot，再把整个 robotik 记成“研究和运用机器人的领域”：一台机器是 robot，一门学问是 robotik。

etymology.historical_story: Rezeki comes from Arabic rizq, meaning provision or sustenance. In Malay Muslim usage, the idea reaches beyond wages and food to include knowledge, health, affection, and other benefits. This breadth explains why someone may describe an unexpected opportunity as rezeki: the word connects everyday livelihood with gratitude for what one receives. [Mufti Perlis: Erti Rezeki](https://muftiperlis.gov.my/index.php/minda-mufti/540-menginsafi-erti-rezeki-dalam-hidup)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 rezeki 联想到一句完整的话：Cari rezeki, syukuri rezeki——努力谋生，也感恩所得。

etymology.historical_story: English ruby reached Middle English through French forms associated with medieval Latin names for a red stone. Its history connects the gemstone with redness, which explains the later colour meaning. In Malay, DBP supplies batu delima for the gem and merah delima for the colour. [Word history](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/ruby)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 /ˈruːbi/ 联想成一颗“如火般红”的宝石：ruby → 红宝石；马来语对应 batu delima。此联想不是词源。
